jobs.title: Farm School Teacher and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Ray of Sunshine Farm is looking for an energetic, organized and entrepreneurial Farm School Teacher & Program Coordinator to take ownership of our children's farm education program.

This is more than a teaching position. We're looking for someone who loves kids, loves nature and animals and can run the program from end to end, from helping get the word out, managing registration and communication with families, teaching our prepared curriculum or developing your own, and then delivering a wonderfuland memorable hands-on experience at the farm.

Our parent/guardian accompanied farm classes introduce young children to animals, gardening, food and agriculture through real experiences: feeding animals, collecting eggs, planting seeds, harvesting vegetables, exploring the garden, and learning about life on a working farm.

The role:

Teaching & program delivery

* Lead engaging, age-appropriate classes for young children
* Teach through hands-on experiences with our animals, gardens and crops
* Follow and improve existing lesson plans and develop new activities over time
* Lead songs, crafts and farm activities
* Confidently manage groups of children while maintaining appropriate safety rules
* Create a warm, welcoming experience for children and their parents/caregivers
* Prepare materials before class and reset/clean up afterward

Program management & administration

* Own the class calendar and coordinate upcoming sessions
* Set up and maintain classes and registration on our website
* Monitor enrollment and manage class rosters
* Communicate with registered families before and after classes
* Answer routine questions from prospective families
* Manage cancellations, transfers, waitlists and other registration details
* Track enrollment and identify classes that need additional promotion
* Maintain supplies and anticipate what will be needed for upcoming classes

Marketing & enrollment

* Help keep classes full by actively promoting upcoming programs
* Create and post class announcements on appropriate local and social media channels
* Help with email/newsletter and social-media promotion
* Reach out to local parent groups, preschools, schools and community organizations
* Develop relationships that can generate repeat enrollment and referrals
* Look for new opportunities to grow the program, including new class ideas, age groups, special events and seasonal programs

Who we're looking for:

This position would be a great fit for someone who combines a natural ability with children with strong organization and initiative.

You don't need to arrive knowing everything about farming. We can teach you about our animals, gardens and farm routines. It's much harder to teach someone how to engage a group of young children, communicate well with parents, stay on top of administrative details and take genuine ownership of a program.

Experience in preschool or elementary education, outdoor education, children's programming, camps, recreation programs, nature education, program coordination or a similar field would be valuable.

We're especially interested in someone who:

* Loves working with young children
* Is warm and engaging while still comfortable being in charge
* Is extremely reliable and organized
* Communicates professionally with parents
* Is comfortable using websites, email, social media and online registration tools
* Doesn't need to be told every small thing that needs to happen
* Enjoys building something and thinking about how to make it better
* Is comfortable outdoors, around animals and getting dirty

What success looks like:

A successful person in this role isn't just someone who teaches a great class. The whole program runs well because they own it and they are looking to grow with the farm!

Families know what's happening. Registration is accurate. Classes are promoted early enough to fill. Materials are ready. Parents get their questions answered. Classes start on time. Children have a great experience. And after each session, you're already thinking about how to make the next one even better.

About Ray of Sunshine Farm

Ray of Sunshine Farm is a small working farm in San Jose's Almaden Valley. We grow fruits and vegetables, raise a variety of farm animals, and create opportunities for families and children to experience agriculture firsthand.

Our farm school isn't intended to recreate a classroom outdoors. We want children to touch, explore, participate, ask questions and develop a real connection with each other, the animals, plants, food and the natural world.

**Schedule:** Part-time and flexible; combination of scheduled classes and flexible administrative hours

Pay: $28.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Delivery Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.
* Experience building reporting packages or KPI dashboards for an executive audience.

Molex is seeking a dynamic and proactive Account Manager to join our Hyperscale account management team. As an Account Manager, you will manage your assigned business units within this strategic customer and be responsible for the profitable growth of Molex business by creating new demand and defending existing business.

This position carries a high degree of autonomy and will serve as the primary contact between Molex and the customer, educating the customer and their partners on the value that Molex brings to their infrastructure architecture. To enable this, you will interface seamlessly with many internal Molex functions including other members of the Global Sales & Marketing team, Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance.

**What You Will Do In Your Role**

* **Strategic Account Management:** Develop and maintain strong relationships with technical and commercial influencers at the customer and internally.
* **Revenue & Pipeline Growth:** Manage the assigned portfolio to achieve revenue/profit growth targets and demand creation pipeline goals.
* **Opportunity Generation:** Identify strategic business opportunities and present business cases to internal stakeholders to gain the necessary support to execute.
* **NPI Program Execution:** Coordinate internal cross-functional teams to guarantee overall success of NPI programs, including key milestone tracking and ensuring Molex performance is aligned with customer expectations.
* **Supply & Demand Coordination:** Track and coordinate demand fulfillment with APO, CM sales, and supply planning teams.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Own reporting and analytics across all business units. Track revenue and profitability of the assigned portfolio and ensure the business is captured accurately across all Molex systems.
* **Strategy Articulation:** Identify value drivers for the assigned customer portfolio and articulate strategy and business needs to leadership.
* **CRM Management:** Track and document these actions and results in our Customer Relationship Management tool. Become a subject matter expert on Molex capabilities and the product portfolio.

**Skills & Abilities**

* **Technical Acumen:** Ability to map complex technical requirements to capabilities and products and develop a customer engagement strategy.
* **Self-Motivated & Curious:** Ability to work through ambiguity to deliver the desired outcome with minimal direct supervision.
* **Communication & Influence:** Effective communicator face-to-face, remotely via phone/video, and via email. Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships, network, and influence others, both internally and at the customer.
* **Operational Excellence:** Organization, attention to detail, timely follow-through, and time management skills to address multiple priorities simultaneously.
* **Analytical Prowess:** Ability to understand complex data sets and process data using Excel and other tools.

**The Experience You Will Bring (Requirements)**

  

* A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent, in business or a technical discipline.
* Customer-facing experience in a sales, account manager, or equivalent technical role.
* Proven ability to manage high-level, complex engagements with Tier 1 hyperscale, cloud, or enterprise data center customers.

* Experience calling on consumer product or hyperscale OEMs, with a proven track record of design wins.

For this role, we anticipate paying $120,000- $180,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form .

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
*Empowering Wellness, Transforming Lives*

Optima Medical Management Group is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life by promoting wellness. At Optima MMG and all of its divisions: Serene Health, Community Support, and American TrueCare, our mission is to provide comprehensive support and care that not only addresses immediate concerns but also fosters long-term well-being.

As pioneers in the field, we aspire to lead in member care outcomes and set new standards for excellence and innovation. We are committed to empowering our members to achieve self-sufficiency in health, creating a ripple effect that strengthens families and communities.

Our work culture at Optima MMG is built on pride, passion, and a collective commitment to making a positive difference in people's lives. Our team members are dedicated problem-solvers who bring their unique skills and perspectives to the table. We believe that by fostering a collaborative and supportive environment, we can unlock the full potential of our team and, in turn, provide the best possible care to our members.

A career at Optima MMG is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organization. We encourage continuous learning and professional growth, providing our employees with access to industry experts, cutting-edge technologies, and a supportive community that values each individual's contributions. Join us on this journey to not only advance your career but to be a driving force in transforming lives and communities through passionate and fulfilling work!

  

***This job is temporarily hybrid. Please see travel details at the bottom.***

**Job Summary:**

The official job title is Lead Care Manager (LCM).

The Lead Care Manager (LCM) role involves developing personalized care plans, coordinating member services, and collaborating closely with members and families, as well as Primary Care Providers to ensure they receive necessary medical treatment and support. The LCM will consult with members to determine their needs, develop individualized action plans, and work with care teams to manage the member experience effectively. Providing emotional support, resolving administrative issues, and ensuring timely access to care are key aspects of the position. Compassion, healthcare knowledge, and exceptional customer service are essential qualities for assisting members in becoming self-sufficient in health. The LCM will work with a diverse population of members enrolled in the Enhanced Care Management program, which may involve one or multiple members from the population of focus section below.

**Responsibilities:**

* Interview members to assess medical and social determinant of healthcare gaps and provide education about their condition and medication, while developing individualized care plans.

* Respond to member inquiries and concerns, ensuring adherence to hospital and legal requirements.

* Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, locate medical and social resources, and coordinate social service plans.

* Maintain on-going contact with members, via telehealth and in-person visitation.

* Advocate for members, consult with healthcare providers, arrange appointments and treatment plans, evaluate member progress, and assist with healthcare barriers.

* Maintain empathy and professionalism while contacting members and families.

* Supporting behavioral health coordination, Substance Abuse and Community Resources.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

  

**Populations of Focus:**

* **Individuals experiencing homelessness:** Lacking a fixed, regular, and adequate nighttime residence.

* **Individuals at risk for avoidable hospital or emergency department utilization:** Five or more emergency room visits in a six-month period that could have been avoided with appropriate outpatient care or improved treatment adherence.

* **Individuals with Serious Mental Health and/ or substance use disorder needs:** Adults who meet the eligibility criteria for participation in, or obtaining services through Specialist mental health services or the Drug Medi-Cal organized delivery system or Drug Medi-Cal program.

* **Individuals transitioning from incarceration/Justice Involved:** Adults transitioning from a correctional setting or transitioned from a correction setting within the past 12 months, or children and youth who are transitioning from a youth correctional facility or transitioned from being in a youth correctional facility within the past 12 months.

* **Adults living in the community and at risk for long-term care institutionalization:** Adults who are living in the community who meet the SNF Level of Care criteria; or who require lower-acuity skilled nursing or equipment for prevention, diagnosis, or treatment of acute illness or injury.

* **Adult nursing facility residents transitioning to the community:** Adult nursing residents who are interested in moving out of the institution, and are likely candidates to do so successfully, and are able to reside continuously in the community.

* **Children and youth enrolled in California Children's Services (CCS) or CCS Whole Child Model (WCM) with Additional Needs Beyond the CCS condition:** Children and youth enrolled in CCS or CCS WCM and are experiencing at least one complex social factor influencing their health.

* **Children and Youth Involved in Child Welfare**

* **Individuals with Intellectual/ Developmental Disabilities:** Adults who have a diagnosed I/ DD and qualify for eligibility in any other adult ECM population of focus.

* **Pregnant and Postpartum individuals; Birth Equity Population of Focus:** Adults and youth who are pregnant or postpartum and qualify for eligibility in any other adult or youth ECM POF, or are subject to racial and ethnic disparities.

**Education and Experience:**

* High school diploma or GED required.

* Minimum of 1 year experience in case management, member care, customer

------------------

DoorDash Digital Ordering is DoorDash's first software-as-a-service business unit – offering a suite of services across online ordering, branded mobile apps, loyalty solutions, and more that enable merchants (restaurants, grocers, retailers, etc.) to reach customers through their own first-party channels.

The business is one of the fastest-growing segments within DoorDash, and yet is only scratching the surface of a generational opportunity to better serve hundreds of thousands of merchants to help them grow their business and improve working lives in one of the country's biggest industry sectors.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Associate Manager on the Digital Ordering Strategy & Operations team, you will play a critical role in building a world-class SaaS business. You will be responsible for defining and leading key go-to-market bets and initiatives to scale our business nationwide. The ideal candidate for this role should be a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, able to take ownership and create plans from scratch, and drive execution while obtaining cross-functional buy-in to achieve Digital Ordering's strategic goals.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Lead.** You'll drive high visibility, cross-functional workstreams that address Digital Ordering's most unique and challenging questions
* **Build.** You'll shape strategies, workstreams, and playbooks across our most important go-to-market priorities, working closely with senior stakeholders across GTM, product, marketing, and beyond

* **Operate.** You'll get to the lowest level of detail and have a deep understanding of how our go-to-market engine operates, and use that to scale
* **Analyze.** You'll parse complex data sets paired with qualitative feedback to provide insights and recommendations to grow the business

------------------------------------

* You solve problems from first principles. You rethink problems from the ground up, and resist "this is how it's always been done" thinking.

* You thrive leading cross-functional teams. You can empathize with diverse perspectives, chart the right path, and influence senior teammates who don't report to you
* You're highly analytical and find the signal through the noise. You are equally at home picking apart funnel metrics as you are pulling insights from 50+ sales calls
* You're equally comfortable operating at 10,000 feet and 1 foot. You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're just as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team. No job is beneath you.

jobs.description:

This is a strategy-to-execution role focused on post-acquisition integration: bringing acquired companies' legal teams, legal entities, contracts, litigation and matters, outside counsel relationships, and compliance obligations into the Lyft Legal organization. jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

At Friends of the Children – SF Bay Area (Friends-SF), we are breaking the cycle of generational poverty by empowering youth to achieve their big dreams. Each child in our program is paired with a long-term, salaried, professional mentor, a Friend, who walks alongside them from kindergarten through high school graduation, for 12+ years, no matter what.

Founded in 2017, Friends-SF is part of a nationwide network with a 30-year track record of proven impact. We proudly serve the Bayview-Hunters Point community and are committed to expanding our reach across the Bay Area.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

Our Friends show up for children every single day. Behind every outing, family event, and new staff member’s first day is an operations team making sure the space is ready, the supplies are stocked, the vendors show up, and nothing falls through the cracks.

We’re looking for an Operations Manager to be the organization-wide operational backbone of Friends-SF. You’ll build and manage the systems, facilities, vendor relationships, and everyday workflows that let our staff do their best work, so they can focus on what matters most: our youth and families.

This is a hands-on manager role with real cross-functional reach. You’ll partner with Program, Development, Operations, and Leadership, turning big-picture priorities into calendars, procedures, and systems that just work. If you love bringing order to a busy environment, take pride in a well-run space, and want your work to directly support kids and families, we’d love to meet you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Build systems that help everyone do their best work**

* Develop, document, and continuously improve organization-wide procedures, workflows, templates, and shared systems

* Translate leadership priorities into clear work plans, timelines, owners, and follow-up

* Maintain the master organizational calendar for key deadlines, board and organizational events, trainings, and compliance activities

* Coordinate organization-wide meetings, retreats, trainings, and special projects from logistics to follow-up

* Spot recurring bottlenecks and pain points, and put practical solutions in place

* Keep shared files and resources organized so staff can always find what they need, and help teams adapt when new tools or practices are introduced

**Keep our spaces safe, welcoming, and ready**

* Lead day-to-day facilities operations, including building access, maintenance, supplies, furniture, and equipment

* Serve as the primary point of contact for contractors, facilities vendors, and service providers

* Coordinate preventative maintenance, repairs, inspections, and facilities projects

* Support workplace safety and emergency preparedness, drills, and incident documentation

* Make sure youth- and family-facing spaces are welcoming, functional, and ready for programming

**Steward our vendors and resources**

* Manage vendor relationships, service agreements, renewals, and purchasing processes in partnership with leadership and finance

* Track contracts, subscriptions, licenses, insurance certificates, and renewal deadlines

* Maintain inventories of supplies, technology, furniture, and emergency supplies

* Find opportunities to reduce costs, consolidate vendors, and use resources more efficiently

**Keep the finance and admin details on track**

* Track the operations budget and share regular updates on spending, forecasts, and variances

* Coordinate invoice routing, coding support, receipts, and purchasing documentation for finance

* Support annual budgeting and gather documentation for audit, insurance, grant, and board reporting

**Keep our technology and tools running smoothly**

* Coordinate day-to-day technology and equipment needs with our external IT provider

* Manage device, account, and access logistics for onboarding and offboarding

**Support a great staff experience**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience

* 4 to 6 years of progressively responsible experience in nonprofit operations, business operations, office or facilities management, administration, project management, or a related field

* Experience juggling multiple work streams, projects, deadlines, vendors, and stakeholders

* Hands-on experience with facilities, purchasing, contracts, budget tracking, and administrative systems

jobs.title: Senior Pharmacovigilance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

The Senior Drug Safety Operations Manager provides senior-level, hands-on operational leadership and oversight for postmarketing and clinical pharmacovigilance activities. The role is accountable for high-quality review and compliant handling of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), effective oversight of outsourced pharmacovigilance services, safety-data reconciliation, regulatory reporting compliance, and safety activities supporting Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) and other postmarketing programs.
  
  
The incumbent serves as a subject-matter resource for case management and PV operations, develops and implements scalable PV processes, and leads PV inspection-readiness activities using a risk-based approach. The role partners closely with Drug Safety physicians, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, REMS stakeholders, Information Technology, business partners, and external vendors to support marketed and investigational products.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Perform hands-on review and quality assessment of clinical-trial and postmarketing ICSRs from spontaneous, solicited, literature, partner, specialty pharmacy, patient support, medical information, product complaint, REMS, digital, and other relevant sources.
* Assess case validity, Day 0, seriousness, expectedness, causality, reportability, MedDRA coding, follow-up needs, and overall case quality.
* Develop/review clear case narratives and company comments, escalating cases requiring medical judgment or Safety Physician input.
* Ensure appropriate coding, follow-up, and handling of special situations, including pregnancy, medication errors, overdose, misuse/abuse, off-label use, lack of efficacy, and product quality complaints with AEs.
* Review and approve ICSRs before submission or partner exchange and manage complex case activities, including duplicates, linking, nullification, upgrades/downgrades, follow-ups, and transfers.
* Author and maintain Safety Management Plans, participate in study team meetings, and perform SAE reconciliation to ensure accurate and compliant safety data.
* Monitor reporting and exchange timelines, submission status, failures, and overdue items; escalate and document compliance issues through resolution. Provide accurate safety database outputs, listings, and case-level analyses for aggregate reports, health-authority responses, inspections, audits, and other regulatory deliverables, while maintaining inspection-ready evidence of reviews, decisions, escalations, and oversight activities.
* Provide risk-based oversight of global PV vendors and service providers across safety intake, processing, medical review, submission, literature, and reconciliation.
* Monitor vendor performance, compliance, quality, deviations, CAPAs, training, and trends; drive governance actions to closure.
* Support vendor qualification, onboarding, training, change management, business continuity, audits, performance reviews, and PV/Safety Data Exchange Agreements.
* Support oversight of the global safety database, including workflows, access, validated changes, data outputs, testing, migration, and system/process implementation.
* Coordinate safety-data reconciliation across internal and external sources and resolve missing cases, duplicates, mismatches, and transfer failures.
* Support REMS and postmarketing PV activities, including AE collection, processing, reconciliation, vendor guidance, deviations/CAPAs, and regulatory safety reporting.
* Develop and maintain scalable PV procedures, work instructions, tools, conventions, and training materials.
* Investigate and trend deviations and quality issues; support CAPAs and effectiveness checks.
* Lead PV inspection readiness and support audits and inspections, including preparation, evidence coordination, responses, and remediation.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, automation, workload planning, and implementation of regulatory or industry changes.
* Serve as a senior PV operations SME across ICSR management, vendor oversight, reconciliation, and compliance; provide cross-functional leadership, risk communication, coaching, and work direction.
Support PV activities for REMS and other postmarketing programs, including AE collection, processing, follow-up, reconciliation, vendor guidance and training, review of REMS procedures and materials, investigation of deviations and CAPAs, and preparation and quality review of safety data supporting REMS Assessment Reports and FDA responses.  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, or a related healthcare or scientific discipline required; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred.
* Minimum 8 years of progressive pharmaceutical, biotechnology, contract research, or related experience, including at least 5 years of direct pharmacovigilance operations experience; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Substantial hands-on experience with clinical trial and postmarketing ICSR intake, data entry, quality review, case assessment, narrative writing, follow-up, and regulatory submission, authoring Safety Management plan and SAE reconciliation is required.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing outsourced PV activities and managing vendor performance, quality issues, deviations, CAPAs, and escalations.
* Experience supporting a marketed product, product launch, REMS, patient support program, specialty pharmacy, call center, or other organized postmarketing data-collection program is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience preparing for and supporting pharmacovigilance regulatory inspections and aud

The mission of the Clinic Operations Manager at ACES is to elevate the standards in the treatment of Autism by providing administrative support to ACES’ clinical staff.

The role supports clinic operations through strategic scheduling, staff coordination, and client engagement to ensure optimal service delivery and prescription fulfillment. It involves managing Behavior Interventionist (BI) onboarding, performance, and satisfaction, while collaborating with HR and Clinical Directors to address staffing needs and retention. Additionally, the position oversees front desk duties, facility maintenance, and promotes center events to enhance client experience and operational efficiency.

Working under the Clinical Director, essential job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* **Scheduling Support**

  + Follow established scheduling protocols and software use to manage session cancellations and rescheduling for in center clients
  + Collaborate with Clinical Directors regularly to meet prescription fulfillment
  + Coordinate assessment scheduling between assessors and new clients
* **BI Support and Management**

  + Collaborate with HR on BI-related needs (e.g., payroll, additional supports) and provide strategic input on hiring by assessing client staffing needs; participate in interviewing potential BI candidates
  + Support BI onboarding and integration by coordinating welcome activities, tech setup (iPads, I-9s, badges), and addressing early concerns in collaboration with onboarding team; serve as a positive first point of contact for new staff.

  + Oversee the BI annual review process by ensuring accurate collection and reporting of clinical and non-clinical scorecard data in alignment with organizational standards
  + Provide oversight of RBT credentialing, including initial steps, actions to maintain certification, renewal processes, and ensuring compliance with 5% BCBA supervision requirements
* **Client Supports**

  + Serve as a positive contact for in center clients and caregivers
  + Collaborate with caregivers to identify opportunities for make-up sessions or extending service hours to maximize prescription fulfillment
* **Center Needs**

  + Maintain a clean, organized, and compliant clinic environment by monitoring staff presentation, coordinating supply and custodial needs, and communicating facility-related requests (e.g., repairs, materials, furniture) to appropriate teams to ensure a safe and functional workspace.
  + Oversee daily clinic operations, including opening and closing procedures; coordinate Manager on Duty coverage in collaboration with office leadership
  + Monitor center space utilization and coordinate scheduling of physical therapy sessions and assessments to maximize efficiency and meet client needs
  + Conduct in-center tours for prospective clients, highlighting the clinic’s physical space and clinical excellence.
  + Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting staff and caregivers, answering phones, relaying messages, and ensuring proper sign-in/out procedures.
  + Manage incoming mail and packages, ensuring timely distribution and handling in accordance with center protocols
  + Promote center events by posting announcements and sending reminders to increase attendance and engagement.

* Strong background in customer service; experience in client-facing roles preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision

* Maintains a professional demeanor, positive attitude, and polished appearance

jobs.title: Senior Creative Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  
  
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

  

**About this role**

The Brand Ops & Production team is seeking an experienced Senior Creative Operations Manager to lead, scale, and optimize delivery across our highest-velocity marketing engines. Partnering closely with Digital and Demand Gen Creative, Production, and Marketing stakeholders, you will build predictable workflows that ensure high-volume creative assets launch on time, at scale, and to our highest brand standard.

You are an organized, proactive creative operations manager who thrives in fast-paced environments. You build clean plans in our project management system, sequence tasks, surface dependencies early, and keep all work visible in one place. You communicate clearly across teams and take pride in being the operational engine that helps work ship on time.

**What you will do**

* Design, implement, and continuously optimize end-to-end creative operations for global demand generation and digital web channels.
* Build and maintain single-source-of-truth project plans—managing tasks, creative resources, asset dependencies, cross-functional handoffs, localization, and stakeholder/legal approvals in one place.
* Prioritize incoming project requests against creative capacity while keeping stakeholders aligned through clear, proactive status updates.
* Serve as the lead operational partner to Digital and Demand Gen creative teams—guiding design and copywriting bandwidth, leading weekly project syncs, mitigating delivery risks, and integrating work into the broader brand operations pipeline.
* Champion project management systems (e.g., Asana) and asset infrastructure, using workflow automations and AI tools to cut manual tracking and boost speed-to-market.
* Oversee agency, localization, and freelance partners, ensuring deliverables align with project scopes, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Track and analyze key performance metrics (cycle time, throughput, and capacity utilization) to continuously refine processes and improve team delivery.

**What experience you have**

* Experience in creative operations, project management, or program management within high-growth B2B tech environments, digital agencies, or in-house marketing creative teams.
* Strong understanding of digital and performance marketing asset ecosystems, including paid media, email marketing, web optimization, ABM campaigns, and multi-touch nurture journeys.
* Exceptional organization, tracking, and scheduling skills, with a bias for transparent, central visibility across all workflows.
* Proven expertise in project management platforms (Asana preferred) with a discipline for building and maintaining clean, accurate, and up-to-date plans.
* Proactive, clear communication and comfort coordinating across multiple teams and stakeholders
* The ability to manage many concurrent projects without dropping details
* Comfort working quickly and adapting as priorities shift
* An interest in using AI and automation to take manual work off the team's plate
* A collaborative, reliable, and solutions-oriented mindset.

**Why you should be excited about this role**

* You will keep two of our most active creative teams running smoothly
* You will be the reason work ships on time and at a high bar
* You will help shape how the creative team operate, including how they use AI to work smarter
* You will work with fun, talented, and collaborative creatives who are passionate about doing their best work together

**Why we are excited about you**

* You are a systems thinker: you see the big picture across complex campaigns and build repeatable frameworks rather than applying quick fixes.
* You drive velocity & high standards: you know how to accelerate pipeline velocity without sacrificing creative quality or brand integrity.
* You inspire confidence: stakeholders and cross-functional teams trust your roadmaps, transparency, and strategic oversight under pressure.
* You are organized, clear, and reliable under a heavy flow of work.
* You are a strong communicator and have the ability to connect across cross functional teams

P25293

jobs.description:
**Area Operations Manager – East Bay**
======================================

BODYROK · Full-time · Salaried (exempt)

BODYROK offers high-intensity, low-impact workouts that will tone, refine, and sculpt your body & mind in just 45 minutes. Our instructors have earned the reputation for delivering some of the most challenging and comprehensive workouts in California. We combine our proprietary Hybrid Pilates method taught on custom-built reformers to deliver one of the most efficient full-body workouts there is. Our trainers are connected to a microphone instructing to heart-pumping music in high-energy studios. The BODYROK method is built to be high-intensity & low-impact leaving our clients energized and feeling great!

We are looking for enthusiastic, motivated, and hardworking individuals who are passionate about health, fitness, and the BODYROK brand.

**Studio locations:** Berkeley, Oakland, Rockridge, Alamo, Walnut Creek (6th studio coming soon)

**Reports to:** Operations Director

**Job Summary**

* The Area Operations Manager ensures that all operations functions within the studio provide the best member experience, and team member environment, and contribute to the studio's financial success.

  

* The Operations Manager recruits, interviews, trains, develops, and schedules a diverse team and provides leadership and direction to ensure the team achieves goals.

  

* This position is responsible for communicating and upholding company policies, and standards and delivering on our commitment to a clean, friendly, and well-maintained studio.

  

* Responsible for the successful attainment of studio targets (e.g. member service, cleanliness, revenue, and retention).

  

* Ensures that the facility is well equipped, and provides a clean and safe environment for both members and employees.

  

* The primary duty of this role is management. The majority of working time is spent managing studio operations and directing, scheduling, training and evaluating the studio team.

* Manage studio operations/studio walkthroughs

  

* Manage Studio Advisor scheduling

  

* Manage Studio Advisor time & attendance

  

* Create and implement retail & water inventory/sales reporting

  

* Studio Advisor hiring i.e. phone interviews & assist with in-person interviews

  

* Manage Studio Advisor onboarding

  

* Manage studio binders

  

* Manage Studio Advisor written warnings and disciplinary documentation

  

* Manage time and attendance and payroll submission for Studio Advisors

  

* Manage supply logs - per studio

  

* Supply distribution as needed

  

* Oversee cleanliness of studios

  

* Manage studio audits

  

* Manage and conduct Studio Advisor performance reviews

  

* Manage community events for the East Bay. Must have a strong passion for building community in and outside of the studio and have a passion to build community in the two new markets we are going into this year.

  

* Coordinate studio repairs and maintenance through approved vendors. This role is not required to perform repair, maintenance or construction work.

  

* Available for occasional weekend coverage, in studio or at a community event, on a rotating schedule

  

* Must be available three times a week for team conference calls

  

* Must be in studio a minimum of five days a week

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work in the studio; move about studio floors and rooms; review, revise, and create studio paperwork; communicate with employees, members, and the public

  

* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 lbs.

  

* The employee occasionally sits, walks, kneels, and reaches with hands and arms

  

* These requirements may be met with or without reasonable accommodation.

* While performing the duties of this job, regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts

* Must have a personal vehicle to travel between studios.

* Employees on PTO, sick leave or scheduled days off are not expected to work or respond to work matters. Coverage will be arranged in advance.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla is looking for a Supply Chain Operations Manager to launch programs on time, surface the bottlenecks that put those launches at risk, and drive them to resolution. This role is ideal for a structured problem solver who can take ambiguous, cross-functional issues, turn them into clear workstreams, and hold action owners accountable until the work is closed.

The ideal candidate brings a consulting background — or equivalent experience solving diverse problems across many projects — with the executive communication skills to brief leadership and the working-level presence to operate across the organization. You will run a diverse set of initiatives in parallel, distill noise into the few issues that matter, and make sure business needs are met in a fast-moving supply chain environment.

 **What You'll Do**

* Program launch execution: Drive supply chain workstreams so programs launch on time. Identify critical-path bottlenecks across suppliers, internal teams, and sites, and stay on them until they are resolved
* Ambiguity to action: Take unstructured, cross-functional problems and distill them into scoped projects with owners, timelines, and success criteria. Follow up with action owners until issues are closed
* Executive communication: Own leadership communication on key issues, risks, and progress. Distill complex operational noise into clear, decision-ready updates for executives while remaining close to the working level
* Cross-functional problem solving: Partner with Procurement, Planning, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and suppliers to diagnose root causes, align on trade-offs, and implement durable fixes
* Portfolio management: Run multiple initiatives in parallel without dropping business-critical work. Prioritize against launch dates, supply risk, and operational impact so business needs stay met
* Operating cadence: Stand up the forums, trackers, and escalation paths needed to keep launches and issue resolution moving. Surface trends early and drive continuous improvement
* Influence without authority: Build trust across functions and levels. Drive alignment and accountability in a matrixed environment where you may not own every resource

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in supply chain operations, program management, or a similarly structured, cross-functional problem-solving role
* Consulting background strongly preferred — experience solving diverse problems across multiple projects, with demonstrated executive communication
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguous problems, structure them into functional workstreams, and drive action owners to resolution
* Track record of launching programs or delivering complex initiatives on time in a fast-paced operational environment
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including briefing executives and working effectively with all levels of the organization
* Ability to manage a diverse set of initiatives in parallel while keeping business needs, priorities, and stakeholders aligned
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills (issue trees, root cause analysis, 5-Why, data-driven recommendations)
* Comfort operating in a high-ambiguity, high-velocity manufacturing or supply chain environment
* Experience influencing cross-functional partners without direct authority

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program

  

#### **Expected Compensation**

$144,800 - $288,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

  
Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Material Design, Google Design Platform
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience with product development.
* Experience with design system development.
* Experience with cross-functional sprint development.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience with partner management.
* Experience managing external agencies.
* Experience using AI tools at scale.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

Google Design Platform (GDP) is a cross-product, cross-platform design and engineering team. We take the most impactful design opportunities and make them a reality through UX guidance and platform code. We make Google’s products more efficient at building beautifully designed products for everyone.

We deliver the highest quality Material design and engineering to Google and the world. We do this through our platforms (Android, iOS, Web) by creating design guidelines, specs and reusable components. We help 1P customers throughout the GDP customer experience journey.

In this role, you will partner closely with the cross-functional Material Design team (UX, UXR, PM, Engineers) to drive one of our top initiatives for the year. You will play a critical role in the UX process - helping to plan and drive sprints with our internal UX team and 1P partners, managing third-party agencies, working with our UXR team to integrate research and partnering with our Engineering team and platform PgMs to execute within components. Other projects include managing narrative content programs and product icon development with cross-functional teams.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive UX design development (including sprints) and partnership with 1P teams and execution within the Material Design team. Projects also include managing narrative content programs and product icon development with cross-functional teams.
* Take responsibility for release schedules and milestones, keeping up a high velocity in a fast-paced environment.
* Manage intake and prioritization of new projects with cross-functional partners and other Program Manager (PgM) team members. Ensure resourcing against key efforts.
* Coordinate and manage dependencies within GDP and with cross-Google partners.
* Manage project schedules, identify possible issues and clearly communicate them to project stakeholders, including material and GDP leadership.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Triage and respond to incoming energy data and analytical requests track progress against internal KPIs and stakeholder expectations.  
  
Maintain and improve reporting documentation the what when where how and why of energy data collection including team specific nuances and process flows.

* Minimum 7 years of experience with at least 3 years of direct hands on experience working with large datasets collecting QA QCing reconciling and analyzing data from multiple sources

  

* Familiarity with corporate GHG emissions accounting concepts Scope 1, 2 and 3 and the activity data that underpins an emissions inventory

  

* Exceptional project management skills with a demonstrated ability to self manage complex data driven delivery in a fast paced matrixed environment

Overview:

**SUMMARY**

The Innovation with Academia (IWA) Student Prototyping Senior Problem Sourcing Program Manager serves as a program leader within the Defense Innovation Unit's Innovation with Academia program. IWA connects Department of War (DoW) mission problems with university talent, research, and expertise to develop pathways from problem discovery through prototyping, commercialization, transition, and ultimately capability the Department can use.

The IWA Student Prototyping program utilizes experiential learning to inspire students to experience work in the National Security Industrial Base by matching highly talented undergraduate and graduate students to deliver rapid, early-stage prototypes, whether technical or policy centered, that help solve the mission partner’s problem.

The Senior Program Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, performance, and continuous improvement of IWA’s student prototyping programs and initiatives. This role translates strategic direction into executable program plans, coordinates across government, academic, industry, and contractor stakeholders, and ensures program activities remain aligned to mission needs, milestones, and intended outcomes.

The Senior Program Manager serves as the primary leader, subject matter expert, and ambassador for the program. This position is responsible for the planning, execution, performance management, and continuous improvement of program activities. The Senior Program Manager oversees all phases of the program lifecycle, ensuring successful delivery of objectives, alignment with client requirements, and achievement of organizational goals.

The ideal individual will have the ability to exercise good judgment in a diversity of situations, with excellent written and verbal communication, analytical, interpersonal, and organizational skills, and the ability to maintain a realistic balance among multiple priorities and equities in a high-tempo environment serving DIU’s mission.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative and results-driven professional with strong program management, stakeholder engagement, and operational leadership skills. This role requires the ability to manage complex initiatives, coordinate cross-functional teams, oversee budgets and resources, and effectively communicate with government, academic, and internal stakeholders.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Management and Execution**

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of assigned IWA student prototyping program(s) and initiatives.
* Translate government direction and program objectives into executable plans, milestones, deliverables, and operating rhythms.
* Ensure successful delivery of program requirements, milestones, deliverables, and outcomes.

jobs.description:
**Join MatPel Builders as a Assistant Project Manager and help shape some of the most stunning homes in the Bay Area.**

MatPel Builders is a premier general contractor based in the San Francisco Bay Area, specializing in architecturally significant, high-end residential construction. Our portfolio includes modern custom homes, historic renovations, complex remodels, and structural retrofits, each reflecting exceptional craftsmanship, thoughtful design, and close collaboration with our clients and project partners.

The Special Projects Division (SPD) is a dynamic and essential part of MatPel. Built on a commitment to exceptional client service and operational excellence, SPD provides continued care for our portfolio of completed homes while managing service and maintenance work, warranty projects, and small to medium-sized renovations. Through these relationships, SPD also creates opportunities for referrals, repeat business, and new project development.

The SPD Assistant Project Manager supports the full project lifecycle, from responding to new project inquiries and evaluating business development opportunities through preconstruction, estimating, execution, and closeout. Working under the direction of the SPD Manager within the Project Management department, the APM develops scopes of work, budgets, and schedules; coordinates with clients, trade partners, and internal teams; and helps manage projects through completion while maintaining established budgets, schedules, and quality standards.

This role requires someone who can effectively manage multiple active projects, service requests, and evolving client needs while delivering a consistently high level of responsiveness and customer service. The SPD APM will also contribute to the continued growth of the division by building strong client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and supporting referrals and repeat business.

Success in this position requires strong organization, communication, judgment, and follow-through, along with the ability to shift between immediate service needs and longer-term project and business development priorities.

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES – Project Lifecycle**

**Estimating & Business Development**

* Support and/or lead the business development process with input from the SPD team.

* Develop and/or review the initial project schedule.

* Ensure estimates accurately reflect project scope, anticipated requirements, and subcontractor work.

  

**Contract Administration & Project Set-Up**

* Review the final project budget with the SPD team.
* Confirm subcontractors and coordinate project startup and scheduling.

* Attend and/or lead preconstruction meetings, site walks, and vendor meetings as required.
* Compile and maintain the project directory.
* Procure and/or coordinate required permits.
* Ensure the project is properly organized and prepared prior to the start of construction.

  

**Project Management & Construction**

* Manage and/or support the project from initial pricing through completion.
* Ensure project scope, schedule, budget, and contractual requirements are actively monitored and managed.
* Maintain and update the project schedule and communicate schedule information to the project team.
* Communicate regularly with the Site Superintendent/Foreman and SPD team.
* Attend and/or facilitate jobsite, OAC, and project meetings as required.

**Scheduling & Field Coordination**

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Capacity Ecosystems
jobs.description:
Meta's Infrastructure organization is seeking a Strategy & Operations Lead to join the Capacity Ecosystems team. This role sits at the intersection of strategic planning, analytical rigor, and large-scale program execution — supporting the decisions and operational systems that govern how Meta plans, allocates, and scales its infrastructure capacity across AI, data center, and compute ecosystems. You will operate with significant autonomy, define the frameworks and operating models the team relies on (including frameworks that support the org's rhythm of business), and drive high priority cross-functional initiatives from problem framing through to measurable outcomes. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complex multi-stakeholder environments, and can influence outcomes at the organizational level without direct authority.  
  
  

### **Strategy & Operations Lead, Capacity Ecosystems Responsibilities:**

* Define and support the analytical frameworks and decision models that inform capacity ecosystem strategy, including demand and supply dynamics, fleet utilization trade-offs, and infrastructure investment prioritization
* Lead the development and evolution of the team's strategic roadmap, synthesizing inputs from infrastructure, finance, supply chain, and engineering partners into a coherent, prioritized plan
* Drive the most complex and ambiguous cross-functional programs end-to-end — scoping initiatives, building execution plans, aligning stakeholders, managing dependencies, and holding teams accountable to delivery milestones
* Identify systemic gaps in capacity planning processes and operational workflows, design solutions, and lead implementation across partner organizations
* Own the design and continuous improvement of team operating cadences, including business reviews, planning cycles, and goal-tracking frameworks that provide leadership with clear visibility into ecosystem health and strategic progress
* Prepare and deliver executive-level briefings, strategic recommendations, and program status communications that accurately represent capacity ecosystem priorities, risks, and decisions
* Serve as a thought partner to the Director of Capacity Ecosystems and other leaders, pressure-testing strategies, surfacing risks early, and proposing course corrections based on data
* Build and scale internal knowledge-sharing and communication mechanisms that keep cross-functional partner organizations aligned on capacity ecosystem strategy and program progress
* Conduct deep-dive analyses on infrastructure capacity topics — including AI compute scaling, data center supply chain economics, and ecosystem bottlenecks — to surface insights that shape long-term strategy

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in strategy and operations, program management, management consulting, or equivalent roles within large-scale technology or infrastructure organizations
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams and senior stakeholders, from initial scoping through delivery and retrospective
* Experience building quantitative models, scenario analyses, and data-driven decision frameworks applied to capacity planning, supply chain, infrastructure investment, or analogous domains
* Experience communicating strategic recommendations, program status, and analytical findings to executive audiences through written briefings, structured presentations, and business reviews
* Experience driving accountability and alignment across teams without direct reporting authority, including escalation management and cross-functional dependency resolution

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into analytical or operational workflows to drive measurable efficiency gains or quality improvements
* Experience building operational processes, goal-tracking systems, or business review cadences from the ground up in ambiguous, rapidly evolving environments
* Background in infrastructure capacity planning, cloud operations, data center supply chain, or AI compute scaling at a hyperscale technology company
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator**
=======================

**Date:** Oct 6, 2026

**Location:** San Jose, California, United States

**Company:** Super Micro Computer

**Job Req ID: 30216**
---------------------

**About Supermicro:**
---------------------

Supermicro® is a Top Tier provider of advanced server, storage, and networking solutions for Data Center, Cloud Computing, Enterprise IT, Hadoop/ Big Data, Hyperscale, HPC and IoT/Embedded customers worldwide. We are the #5 fastest growing company among the Silicon Valley Top 50 technology firms. Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. We seek talented, passionate, and committed engineers, technologists, and business leaders to join us.

**Job Summary:**
----------------

Supermicro is currently looking for a Project Coordinator to join our team.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------

* **Quality Management System Support:** Help maintain and improve the QMS so processes remain aligned with applicable ISO and quality standards, internal procedures, and customer or certification requirements.
* **Internal Auditing:** Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits to assess process effectiveness, measure performance, and identify gaps or nonconformities.
* **Corrective and Preventive Action:** Track operational issues and nonconformities, support root-cause analysis, and work with process owners to implement and verify corrective and preventive actions.
* **External Audit Support:** Serve as a point of contact for certification bodies and other external auditors during compliance, surveillance, and recertification audits; help prepare evidence and follow up on findings.
* **Training and Awareness:** Support employee training and awareness on quality standards, documented processes, and continuous-improvement practices.
* **Document and Record Control:** Maintain controlled documents, records, and logs so quality documentation remains accurate, current, secure, and readily available for operations and audits.
* **Reporting and Follow-Up:** Prepare audit summaries, track open actions, and provide status updates to support management review and ongoing improvement.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Quality Management, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* 1+ years of experience in quality, compliance, auditing, document control, or ISO coordination preferred.
* Experience supporting ISO 9001 or another management system (e.g., ISO 13485) is a plus.
* Experience in technology, operations, logistics, or a service environment is a plus.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); familiarity with databases, document control systems, or audit/QMS software preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work with people across departments.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work in a logical, systematic way and follow issues through to closure.
* Internal auditor training or certification is preferred but not required.

**Salary Range**
----------------

$28.00 - $30.00 /hr

The salary offered will depend on several factors, including your location, level, education, training, specific skills,years of experience, and comparison to other employees already in this role. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation, such as participation in bonus andequity award programs.

**EEO Statement**
-----------------

Supermicro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and embraces diversity in our employee population. It is the policy of Supermicro to provide equal opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or special disabled veteran, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Case Manager / Service Coordinator**
--------------------------------------

**Help residents stay housed, access resources, and build community.**

BHNC is seeking a compassionate, organized Case Manager/Service Coordinator to support adults, older adults, people with disabilities, and families at Bernal Gateway Apartments. This role combines individualized support with resident engagement to strengthen housing stability, wellbeing, and belonging.

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct intakes and needs assessments, develop individual service plans, and follow through on resident goals and referrals.
* Connect residents to benefits, food assistance, healthcare, transportation, legal resources, employment, and family services.
* Help residents navigate lease requirements, recertifications, rent arrears, and resources to prevent eviction.
* Coordinate with property management and community providers while protecting resident confidentiality.
* Respond to crises within your training and role, connecting residents to appropriate support.
* Organize resident meetings, workshops, community events, and leadership opportunities.
* Conduct outreach and maintain accurate service records, attendance data, and outcome documentation.

**What You Bring**

* Strong communication, organization, follow-up, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with resident assessments, service planning, resource navigation, and confidential documentation.
* Knowledge of San Francisco community resources and a commitment to culturally responsive services.
* Preferred but not required; fluency in spoken and written Spanish and effective communication in English.

**Preferred:** Three or more years of case management or service connection experience; affordable housing or community engagement experience; a related college degree; and familiarity with Salesforce, GetCare, Asana, or similar systems.

**Schedule and Benefits**

Monday–Friday, generally 9 a.m.–5 p.m., with occasional evening or weekend activities and travel to other BHNC sites. Benefits include health, dental, vision, and life insurance; 401(k); paid time off and holidays; employee assistance; professional development; paid lunch; and a monthly cell phone stipend, subject to plan terms.

BHNC is an at will, equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:

At TJX Companies, every day brings new opportunities for growth, exploration, and achievement. You’ll be part of our vibrant team that embraces diversity, fosters collaboration, and prioritizes your development. Whether you’re working in our four global Home Offices, Distribution Centers or Retail Stores—TJ Maxx, Marshalls, Homegoods, Homesense, Sierra, Winners, and TK Maxx, you’ll find abundant opportunities to learn, thrive, and make an impact.
