jobs.title: Richmond- ASP Program Leader
jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),

o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or

o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

***After School Program Dates***

* *San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027*

**Job Responsibilities**  
**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.

* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.

* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.

**Supervision & Safety**  
Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.  
Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline

**Record-Keeping & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation

**Communication & Engagement**

* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.

**Training & Development**

* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Job offers are conditional and contingent upon background clearance. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and CA Fair Chance Act, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records for employment.

  

**Salary Description**  
The After School Program Leader position offers a compensation range of $24.00 – $25.50 per hour. This rate is based on salary benchmarking for similar roles and is aligned with grant fund approvals and requirements for the position.

  

**The YMCA of Greater San Francisco is seeking Program Leaders at the following sites:**

* Richmond- Claire Lilienthal Elementary School
* Richmond- Jefferson Elementary School
* Richmond- Sutro Elementary School

jobs.title: Quality lead
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova builds personalized cancer vaccines. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician.

**The role**

We're building a lab, a manufacturing facility and a clinic, and all of them need a quality system. You'll build a fit-for-stage GxP quality management system across them and keep it working as we grow.

**What you'll do**

* Build and mature our GxP quality management system: SOPs, document control and training records
* Run deviations, CAPAs and change control
* Qualify vendors and CDMOs and put quality agreements in place, including with our manufacturing partners
* Set up the batch release process for patient-specific product
* Provide quality oversight across product development, manufacturing, expanded access and clinical work
* Plan audits of sites and vendors, and get us inspection-ready, including our Bozeman clinic
* Set quality rules for our digital systems, automation, data integrity and AI-enabled workflows, built so they don't slow us down
* Own change control for our in-house software and analysis pipeline, which updates often

**Who you are**

* A hands-on quality lead who builds proportionate, risk-based systems from the ground up
* You would never import a big-pharma QMS wholesale
* Comfortable with both the framework and the detail
* High agency, friendly and low ego

**Requirements**

* Hands-on clinical quality (GCP) experience, not only GMP, plus a working knowledge of GMP
* You've run audits, investigations, CAPAs and change control
* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area or London, or remote with regular site visits
* Authorized to work in the US or UK, or a realistic path to get there

**What will make you stand out**

* You've built a QMS at an early-stage biotechnology company
* Quality for digital and automated systems: data integrity, computerized systems, AI-enabled workflows
* Biologics, advanced therapies or oncology
* Vendor and CDMO qualification, quality agreements, batch release
* Multi-site clinical quality, including site readiness and inspections

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco or London, or remote with site visits
* **Type:** Starts as a contract of at least 3 days a week for 12 months, with a path to a permanent role

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Specialist - Drug Substance
jobs.description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

Reporting to the Associate Director for QA at Cytokinetics the QA Specialist for Drug Substance will perform review of batch documentation as part of the QA certification process. The role involves oversight and review of documentation relating to manufacturing, testing, release, and lifecycle management activities performed by Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), Contract Testing Laboratories (CTLs), and other GxP service providers.

  

The candidate will be part of a team that provides QA support and advice to internal and external customers and will execute day-to-day quality issues as they arise at Cytokinetics. They will be part of teams who work with Contract Manufactures for Drug product (DP). The role will provide support to the Qualified Person (QP) function to oversee our QA activities as we continue to supply our products.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provide GMP Quality Assurance oversight for clinical and commercial manufacturing, and distribution activities performed at Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).
* Perform Quality review of clinical and commercial batch records and supporting documentation to ensure compliance with cGMP requirements, approved manufacturing instructions and regulatory filings.
* Review manufacturing, and testing documentation to support batch disposition and product release.
* Review and approve deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls and associated Quality Management System records to ensure timely resolution and appropriate root cause analysis.
* Assess quality events for potential product impact and support risk-based quality decisions.
* Provide Quality support for technology transfers, process validation, engineering batches, process performance qualification (PPQ) and commercial launch activities.
* Review and approve GMP documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Master Batch Records, specifications, protocols, reports and work instructions.
* Participate as the Quality representative on cross-functional teams supporting clinical and commercial programs.
* Support implementation of manufacturing, packaging and process improvements through the change management process.
* Ensure compliance with Cytokinetics Quality Management System requirements, cGMP regulations and applicable global regulatory expectations.
* Support qualification and ongoing Quality oversight of CMOs, contract laboratories and other GMP service providers.
* Participate in internal audits, supplier audits and regulatory inspections, including inspection readiness activities and support for responses to audit observations.
* Support Product Quality Reviews (PQRs), Annual Product Reviews (APRs), Quality Management Reviews and Quality Metrics reporting.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, Supply Chain and Manufacturing partners to support CMC submissions, post-approval changes and regulatory commitments.
* Maintain GMP documentation and Quality records within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS).
* Identify opportunities to improve Quality Systems and GMP processes and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders and external partners on GMP quality requirements.
Perform other Quality Assurance duties as assigned to support business objectives.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering or technical discipline.

* Exposure to using data in spreadsheets and/or databases for risk detection.
* Prior audit experience.
* Ability to recognize the interdependencies among complex business processes to anticipate risk potential.
* Ability to develop recommendations and solutions to complex problems based on data.
* Ability to communicate, in person (virtual) and in writing, complex data and concepts so that the material is easily understood by all levels of management.
* Ability to teach, lead and mentor others.
* Ability to advocate, persuade, and influence other employees from functional level individual contributors to senior leadership creatively and effectively.
* Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to adapt to changing deadlines and priorities.
* Actively shapes our company culture (e.g., participating in employee resource groups, volunteering, etc.).
* Lives into cultural norms (e.g., willing to have cameras when it matters: helping onboard new team members, building relationships, etc.).

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Quality Assurance Manager | Building Envelope & Constructability**

Are you a construction or design professional with deep expertise in building envelopes, waterproofing, façades, and constructability?

This is an opportunity to step into a highly influential role where your technical knowledge will directly impact the quality and success of major construction projects throughout the Bay Area.

Rather than focusing solely on field inspections or traditional QA/QC documentation, this position is centered around design review, constructability, building envelope performance, risk identification, and developing better solutions before problems reach the jobsite.

You will work alongside architects, engineers, consultants, manufacturers, subcontractors, and preconstruction teams to identify potential issues early, develop solutions, and establish best practices across complex projects ranging from $5M to more than $200M.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

As the Quality Assurance Manager, you will serve as a technical resource throughout the design and preconstruction process.

• Perform detailed constructability reviews of design documents across multiple project phases

• Focus heavily on building envelope systems, waterproofing, roofing assemblies, windows, storefronts, accessibility, and other high risk areas

• Identify design deficiencies, constructability concerns, and potential performance issues before construction begins

• Develop practical solutions and recommendations when designs fall below established standards

• Review designs for compliance with California building codes, accessibility requirements, and applicable regulations

• Lead design review meetings with architects, consultants, project teams, and other stakeholders

• Collaborate closely with Preconstruction and Estimating teams to identify risks and opportunities early

• Work directly with waterproofing consultants, manufacturers, specialty contractors, architects, and engineers

• Assist in developing RFIs and technical questions for design teams

• Research new products, materials, systems, and construction practices

• Help transition projects from Preconstruction into Operations by communicating key QA and design issues

• Help develop and maintain company wide QA/QC standards and best practices

• Train project teams on QA/QC standards and building envelope best practices

• Stay current on California building codes, products, technologies, and industry developments

• Support multiple project teams simultaneously while serving as a trusted technical resource

**Why This Role Is Different**
------------------------------

This is a technical leadership position, not simply a traditional QA/QC management role.

Your expertise will be brought into projects early enough to actually influence the outcome. You will have a seat at the table with design and

PRN brings together some of the most trusted PT brands across the West and Central U.S. Whether in the clinic or behind the scenes, we’re all about personalized care, smart clinical insight, and making every patient feel supported from start to finish.

**About the Role**

As a Patient Service Representative at PRN Physical Therapy, you'll be an essential part of our team, providing exceptional customer service and administrative support to ensure a smooth and positive experience for our patients.

**Brand: Cal Rehab & Sports Therapy**

**Pay: $20-23/hr (benefits offered)**

**Schedule: Full-time 40hrs/per week - clinic is open M-F 7am-6pm**

**Duties & Responsibilities**

*Patient Interaction:*

* Greet and welcome patients with professionalism and warmth.
* Schedule appointments and manage patient inquiries both in person and over the phone.
* Collect and verify patient information, insurance details, and necessary documentation accurately.
* Help create a positive work environment and clinic culture by ensuring the patient’s needs are taken care of during transitional periods of therapy. Help provide customer service, a smile.

*Administrative Support:*

* Maintain patient records and ensure all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Assist in keeping front office area neat, tidy and organized.
* Coordinate with clinical staff to ensure seamless patient experience.
* Assist front office with front office tasks when down time occurs including but not limited to: answering the phone, scanning documents into charts, scheduling patients, taking over the counter payments, filing, faxing, etc.

*Communication and Coordination:*

* Liaise effectively between patients, clinical staff, and other departments within the facility.
* Communicate clearly and professionally to address patient concerns or questions.

*Miscellaneous Operations:*

* Maintain a clean and organized reception area.
* Assist in managing inventory and ordering office supplies as needed.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for process improvement.
* Ensure cleanliness and organization of therapy areas and equipment. Daily equipment cleaning, cleaning tables, laundry, stocking supplies.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education in healthcare administration is a plus.
* Proven experience in a customer service role; healthcare setting preferred.
* Proficiency in using office software and scheduling systems.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to maintain professionalism in a fast-paced environment.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in handling patient information and documentation.

**Benefits & Perks**

We offer a comprehensive and competitive compensation package designed to support both personal and professional well being. Team members enjoy full scale benefits—including robust Medical, Vision, and Dental plans—along with paid time off, clinical incentive opportunities, and student loan repayment options. We are committed to your continued growth and success, providing professional development resources and ongoing clinical education support.

At PRN, you’ll be part of a supportive, mission driven environment dedicated to excellence in patient care and the success of every member of our team.

*Note: This job description is a general outline of responsibilities and requirements. Specific duties may vary based on the needs of management.*

jobs.title: Program Manager III, Supply Chain, Technical Infrastructure
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in supply chain risk assessment and supply chain resiliency.
Experience defining system logic, data hierarchies, and automation requirements to transform manual workflows into scalable, repeatable weekly processes.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in supply chain planning, material management, or commodity management within the technology or AI hardware industry.
* Experience designing and implementing end-to-end planning architectures within ERP or advanced planning systems (e.g., SAP or proprietary tools).
* Experience defining system logic, data hierarchies, and automation requirements to transform manual workflows into scalable, repeatable planning engines.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing comprehensive manufacturing and execution strategies by integrating inputs across demand, capacity, material availability, financial budgets, and data center requirements. You will engage with key suppliers and commodity managers to ensure the timely availability of critical components.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop short and long term supply and demand model that seek to maximize supply output while also balancing inventories and critically constrained parts.
* Establish and utilize best methods (statistical models, processes and software tools) in evaluating supply chain’s ability to meet customer demand.
* Lead demand and supply planning meetings with cross-functional teams, reviewing supply, demand risks/mitigation options/service level goals. Collaborate cross-functionally and drive resolution of supply chain exceptions/escalations in a timely manner.
* Prepare, report, and present supply and demand recommendations with sound models and logic to leadership, drive timely decisions, and ensure clear and concise communication to all stakeholders in the supply chain.
* Drive product success by keeping ourselves and others accountable for metrics such as forecast accuracy, on- time delivery, inventory, excess and obsolescence (E&O) and material spend.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.description:
**Department:**

Kinship

  

**Location:**

Hayward, CA

***Lincoln Families is a workplace that is committed to strengths-based, culturally responsive, attachment-centered, and trauma-informed care.***

  

**JOB TITLE:** Program Manager

**PROGRAM:** Kinship

**SALARY:** $90,000 annually

**KINSHIP SUPPORT SERVICES:** Children do best when they remain in safe, stable, and familiar environments that relatives can provide. Relative caregivers are the backbone of the child welfare system, stepping up to fill the gaps when challenges take parents away from raising their children. Many are grandparents with special needs liked to age, poverty, poor health, and lack of support and resources.

  

**WHAT WE DO:** Lincoln Families’ Kinship program provides supports to kin caregivers so they have the resources needed to raise their relative. Since 2001, our staff have addressed the unique needs of each caregiver and child, providing a variety of supports:

* **Family Coaching** - Providing advocacy and referral for financial assistance, legal supports, mental health, emergency, and education services
* **Education and Skill Building** - Offering programs including parenting and school advocacy to prepare and inform caregivers and youth
* **Youth Engagement** - Providing children and teen activity groups, social and recreational outings, tutoring, and workshop events
* **Support Groups** - Facilitating gatherings of caregivers to share joys and concerns, learn about resources, and support each other

**OUR WHY:** Children in foster care can face exposure to alcohol and other drugs, abuse, neglect and abandonment, violence in their homes and communities, trauma from separation from birth families, and frequent changes in foster care placement. These experiences place children at greater risk of developing physical, emotional, and behavioral problems that can lead to school failure, teen pregnancy, homelessness, unemployment, and incarceration. Research shows that living with relatives is better for children and benefits them in many ways. Of children who are not living with their biological parents, 75% of them are being raised by a relative outside of the formal foster care system. Such kin caregivers have little or no time to prepare for this new arrangement and face major barriers in accessing information, benefits, legal assistance, and services.

**POSITION SUMMARY:** Reporting to the Community-Based Services Program Director, this Program Manager provides leadership, budget oversight and accountability for the Kinship Support Services program. The duties include acting as a liaison to Alameda County Department of Children and Family Services, school district(s) in our service area, funding sources, and referring/resource partners.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Ensures quality and accountability in all program functions and services.
* Hires, assesses, supervises, and coaches staff as needed to manage the personnel and service functions of assigned programs.
* Develops and monitors program budgets; provides reports to appropriate agencies in a timely manner.
* Responsible for facilitating communication between program staff and other agency personnel.
* Liaisons with public and private agencies.
* Represents Agency in the area of public relations.
* Develops new programs, expands existing programs according to client, community interest, and needs.
* Anticipates personnel needs. Plans for future and recommends cost effective measures for site development and maintenance.
* Identifies new funding streams for program development and enhancement.
* Ensures all staff maintain HIPAA and COA compliance.
* Participates when needed in board and program committee meetings and other appropriate committee meetings (Budget, Personnel, Facilities, etc.)

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

A positive, relationally adept, service-oriented leader who thrives in a fast-paced, busy environment and is organized to handle often competing deadlines. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to problem-solve as well as coach and develop staff. Must be deadline-driven, detail-oriented and able to maintain high levels of confidentiality and professionalism. Demonstrated awareness of, sensitivity to and competence in dealing with cultural and socioeconomic diversity of client population; knowledge of trauma informed and culturally responsive interventions with youth and families. Committed to helping the organization with equity, diversity and inclusion work both through leading initiatives and engaging in reflective work. Can work independently but also asks for help when necessary.

**EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred (equivalent work experience may be considered)
* Master’s degree in Social Work or human services related field a plus
* 3 years of relevant work experience in human services required
* 1 year of supervisory experience required
* Experience managing program or project budgets preferred
* Experience managing reports to funders and meeting compliance expectations a plus
* Lived experience with kinship caregiving or work experience with kinship families is highly desirable
* Strong computer skills with intermediate proficiency in Microsoft programs and/or Google Suite
* Fluency in Spanish (verbal and written) preferred.

**WHY JOIN LINCOLN FAMILIES:**

* **Salary:** $90,000 annually
* **Time Off**: 4 weeks of vacation, 13 sick days, 5 additional CA paid sick leave days and 11 holidays (including 2 flex holidays); vacation and sick time begin accruing from day one of employment.
* **Benefits**: Medical HRA (Health Reimbursement Arrangement) plan with employer-paid premiums (100% employees and 50% dependents) and employer-paid deductibles with Kaiser; alternate plans also available at employee's cost for Sutter or Health Savings Account. Additional benefit offerings for dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, voluntary life insurance or lo

jobs.title: Program Manager, Sanctions Compliance (OFAC)
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Founded in 1882, Matson (NYSE: MATX) is a leading provider of ocean transportation and logistics services. Matson provides a vital lifeline of ocean freight transportation services to the domestic, non-contiguous economies of Hawaii, Alaska, and Guam, and to other island economies in Micronesia. Matson also operates premium, expedited services from China to Long Beach, California, which includes cargo from other Asia origins, provides services to Okinawa, Japan, and the South Pacific, and operates an international export service from Alaska to Asia.

Matson Logistics extends the geographic reach of Matson's transportation network throughout North America and Asia. Its integrated logistics services include rail intermodal, highway brokerage, warehousing, freight consolidation, supply chain management, and freight forwarding to Alaska.

Matson is honored to be certified as a Great Place to Work. Learn more at www.matson.com.

**About the Role**

The **Program Manager, Sanctions Compliance (OFAC)** serves as Matson’s specialist professional and subject matter resource for enterprise sanctions compliance, restricted-party screening, and related international trade controls. The position independently manages large and complex compliance processes with limited oversight and is responsible for translating applicable sanctions requirements into practical policies, procedures, controls, investigations, training, and business guidance.

The role leads administration and continuous improvement of sanctions screening across relevant counterparties, transactions, shipments, and geographies. It partners across Legal, Operations, Technology, Finance, Procurement, and Commercial functions to strengthen screening coverage, data quality, system reliability, documentation, audit readiness, and timely escalation of potentially significant matters.

This is a hybrid position requiring onsite work at our Corporate Office in Walnut Creek, CA, three (3) days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

**What you’ll do:**

Sanctions screening, investigations, and advisory support; additional Treasury activities

* Prepare clear written findings, recommendations, decision records, and supporting evidence; coordinate required holds, restrictions, approvals, remediation, and follow-up actions through completion.
* Provide practical subject matter guidance to business teams regarding sanctions requirements, control expectations, and risk-mitigation measures.
* Participate in other day-to-day Treasury related tasks, including cash management, compliance (SOX, FBAR, KYC, Nacha, etc.), and bank account maintenance.

Program governance, policies, and risk management

* Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready records demonstrating program execution, decision quality, and control effectiveness.

Technology, data, metrics, and continuous improvement

* Partner with Technology and business system owners to improve screening coverage, data quality, system integrations, workflow reliability, and the compliance evidence trail.
* Provide subject matter leadership for the selection, testing, implementation, and enhancement of sanctions screening platforms, case-management tools, and related compliance technology.
* Develop and maintain metrics, dashboards, and management reporting for screening volume, exceptions, escalations, completion, remediation, and control effectiveness.
* Identify and implement opportunities to automate controls, reduce manual effort, improve timeliness, and strengthen documentation and monitoring.
* Participate in the AI initiative by leveraging AI-driven solutions to enhance processes.

Audit, training, and stakeholder engagement

* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, control testing, assessments, and regulatory inquiries involving sanctions compliance.
* Develop and deliver sanctions compliance training and awareness materials for relevant employees and stakeholders.
* Track corrective actions and process improvements through completion and verify that identified deficiencies are remediated.
* Lead cross-functional workstreams and coordinate the contributions of other professionals; coach or provide technical guidance on sanctions processes as needed.

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

* Demonstrated subject matter expertise in sanctions or restricted-party screening, including investigati

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Insidesource DEI Statement**

By nurturing a culture where everyone experiences a deep sense of belonging and equity of opportunity, we will uphold our vision to “unleash human and business potential.” We commit to being an anti-ism workplace and embedding diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our business.

**Job Summary**

The Account Manager manages accounts and project teams in support of all project and daily work activities, from scope development through task or project completion. With a highly consultative approach, they deliver tailored solutions and full client satisfaction throughout the entire project lifecycle, and build strong, sustainable customer relationships. They are responsible for meeting agreed upon revenue and margin goals.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Client/Account Servicing**

* Develop and nurture client relationships in support of building trust, aligning business requirements, and increasing revenue opportunities and profitability.
* Maintain comprehensive understanding of client needs, goals, business practices and satisfaction/performance criteria.
* Act as single point of contact for coordination and execution of Insidesource activities (ie. Pre- and post-sale).
* Responsible for overall performance of Insidesource account / project teams (sales support, design, project management and field service teams).
* Accountable for end-to-end client experience and satisfaction.
* Provide timely response to customer requests for products, services, and information.
* Ensure generation of weekly status reports.
* Responsible for relevant third-party influencers - contractors, A&D and PM firms, etc. - in relation to client account/projects.

**Sales, Project, and Work Order Management**

* Enter and maintain sales forecast in CRM.
* Partner with New Business Development/Account Executives to respond to requests for information, pricing and/or services; lead RFP response as needed.
* With support from Insidesource teams, produce plans, develop specifications, generate detailed and accurate quotes, and present to customer in timely manner.
* Develop and execute service contracts and service level agreements.
* Deliver responsible close of sale requirements by obtaining signed proposals, terms and conditions, customer purchase orders, and deposits.
* Ensure obstacles and/or changes in scope are identified, documented, and resolved, and ensure client and Insidesource satisfaction throughout project lifecycle.
* Oversee and direct Insidesource implementation of all client projects, work orders, and service requests.
* Review and/or establish work plans, schedules, and logistics.
* Oversee work of all team members, including designers, project managers, account coordinators, delivery, and installation crews.
* Perform project management responsibilities as required, including site visits during installations.
* Provide (and prepare, if required) project and work order status reports.
* Attend project and construction meetings as required.
* Provide exceptional leadership and communication to customer and internal teams.
* Achievement of annual sales goals as established by Manager.

**Leadership and Professional Development**

* Manage positive and productive interactions of internal and external teams, including collaboration with subcontractors and manufacturers.
* Manage workload of internal teams to ensure activities are appropriately balanced and supported.
* Provide mentorship and encourage growth and development of team members.

* Participation in weekly Sales Meetings and Monthly Staff Meetings.
* Regular attendance at industry events.

**Insidesource Core Responsibilities**

* Exemplify Insidesource values of Team First, Client Led, Change Makers, Experience Focused.
* Participate in All Company Meetings and Regional Town Halls.
* Embody diversity, equity, and inclusion in our Insider community and business practices.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None

**Skills, Knowledge, Experience Required**

* Account Management experience in the contract furniture industry required.
* Experience working on RFPs.
* Product knowledge and product specification experience.
* Ability to lead and inspire cross functional players.
* Eye for design and layout of marketing materials.
* Solid skills in copy-editing, grammar, spelling, and punctuation.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Teams, Word, Outlook, Power Point).

* Proficiency in Adobe Systems (Photoshop, InDesign) CORE, Hubspot, Miro, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Understanding of the complexities and sophistication required to thrive in the dealer environment.
* Fluid interpersonal skills to interact effectively with a wide range of customers, vendors, personnel, and departments.
* Ability to see the big picture and integrate into day-to-day tasks and activities.
* Excellent and effective oral and written communication.
* Prior experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced work environment.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and administrative skills
* Experience in customer service required.
* Demonstrated commitment to professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment in business transactions, and to providing the highest level of customer satisfaction.

*The anticipated salary range for this role is $80K-110K. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.*

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Vibrant Wellness is a science-driven biotechnology and health diagnostics company focused on improving health outcomes through advanced testing, reliable data, and collaboration across scientific and business teams.

**Our Vision**

We aim to advance healthcare through data, science, and innovation, helping providers and patients make more informed decisions.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on **Revenue Operations & Marketing Analytics Manager** to improve the systems, processes, and reporting that support our go-to-market strategy.

This role owns HubSpot administration, funnel analytics, marketing attribution, data modeling, and executive reporting. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to improve data quality, understand performance, and turn insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and improve HubSpot workflows, automation, lifecycle stages, lead management, and CRM data structure.
* Build and refine lead-routing rules, sales pipelines, and deal-stage definitions.
* Analyze funnel conversion, pipeline performance, and sales forecasts to identify gaps and opportunities.
* Connect CRM, advertising, campaign, event, and product data to measure marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue.
* Write SQL and build reusable datasets that support accurate, consistent reporting.
* Create executive dashboards and recommend improvements to channel investment, budgets, customer journeys, and growth strategy.
* Improve CRM data quality, system integrations, user adoption, and workflows across teams.

**Skills**

**Required:**

* Advanced HubSpot administration, including workflows, automation, and CRM data architecture.
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, and troubleshooting data issues.
* Experience analyzing B2B funnels and marketing attribution across long sales cycles.
* Ability to build reliable datasets and translate analysis into clear business recommendations.
* Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate across teams, clarify requirements, and bring structure to complex problems.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with dbt or a similar data transformation tool.
* Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Power BI, or Tableau.
* Knowledge of A/B testing, cohort analysis, incrementality, or lift analysis.
* Experience with sales forecasting, territory management, customer journey analysis, or system integrations.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* At least 3 years of relevant experience in revenue operations or analytics, typically gained in a Revenue Operations Specialist or Analyst role.
* Demonstrated experience directly administering HubSpot and improving CRM processes.
* Hands-on experience writing SQL and designing reusable data models or reporting datasets.
* Experience building B2B funnel reporting and connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success.

**Compensation**

Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and applicable law.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and to ensuring equal access to employment opportunities.

If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.

Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

As such, we are seeking an experienced and self-driven Technical Account Manager to join our outstanding Customer Success team. If you are motivated by challenges, have a passion for excellence, and are customer-centric then this could be the opportunity for you. Accountability, motivation, creativity, and tenacity are the key success attributes for this role.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Serve as a technical subject matter expert for Delinea’s Privilege Access services and product offerings
* Be the customer trusted advisor to ensure engagement and success with the Delinea solution deployment, expedite resolutions to obstacles, and help them derive the most out of their Delinea investment.
* Regularly monitor customer health, and communicate results with regional sales team, support, and renewals team

jobs.description:
Olema Oncology is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the standard of care and improving outcomes for patients living with breast cancer and beyond. With our transformation into a fully integrated oncology company well underway, it's an exciting time to be part of Team Olema.

Our lead product candidate, palazestrant, is a novel, orally available complete estrogen receptor antagonist (CERAN) and selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) currently in two pivotal Phase 3 clinical trials. We expect top-line data from OPERA-01, our ongoing Phase 3 trial of palazestrant as a monotherapy in patients with second- or third-line ER+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer (MBC), in Q1 2027 which, if positive, could lead to our first potential approval and commercial launch in 2028. OPERA-02, our Phase 3 trial of palazestrant in combination with ribociblib in patients with frontline ER+/HER2- MBC, is enrolling patients. Together with its mechanism of action, pharmacokinetic properties, and the potential to demonstrate activity in both ESR1 wild-type and mutant tumors, palazestrant could transform the metastatic breast cancer treatment paradigm and provide access to a $15 billion global market opportunity.

Our follow-on product candidate, OP-3136, is a potent KAT6 inhibitor with the potential to generate further value and meaningfully impact the metastatic breast cancer treatment landscape – particularly in combination with palazestrant. We recently presented encouraging Phase 1 monotherapy data from this program across multiple solid tumor types, are advancing patient enrollment in the ongoing combination arms in MBC, and expect to initiate a Phase 1 study of OP-3136 in combination with Bayer's darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer by the end of this year.

Aspiring to transform the metastatic treatment paradigm is an ambitious endeavor that requires a resolute approach to developing better therapies and passionate colleagues dedicated to helping the patients we serve feel better, longer. Team Olema possesses a deep commitment to a shared purpose, the sustained pursuit of excellence, cultivating the courage required to advance our programs, the drive to succeed, and a collective capacity for adaptability through learning, growth, and evolution. We are a small group of nimble self-starters who bring consistency in our quest for the extraordinary every single day.

If you're ready to be part of a tenacious, courageous, agile, and growing team, join us in making a profound impact, together – for our patients, for your career, and for what's beyond.

* Proven track record of launching and supporting consumer hardware, software, or subscription products.
* Ability to grow in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment while leading complex, cross-functional projects.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience presenting to and influencing cross-functional teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

As a Product Support Manager within the gUP Home Product Excellence, you will be a critical partner and trusted advisor to the Home Product team, translating complex user feedback and support data into actionable insights that shape the future of our Home portfolio.

In this role, you will require a deep understanding of the user journey, a passion for product quality, and the ability to engage strategically in a dynamic, cross-functional environment. You will drive product excellence strategy and execution for a discrete feature area, from ensuring flawless launches to driving long-term improvements that fulfill our mission to create a home that takes care of the people inside it and the world around it.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $114000 - $163000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Synthesize user feedback from all channels to identify top issues, product gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Own the product bug hotlist and advocate for resolution for your area of responsibility.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and UX teams, using data-driven insights to influence product decisions and secure resources for top user-reported issues.

* Lead post-launch retrospectives to capture what worked, what didn’t, and what should be incorporated into the next launch cycle

**Sales & Field Enablement**

* Run regular product update sessions (live or async) so the field is never behind on what Agiloft has shipped or is shipping soon
* Track field readiness and confidence as a measurable output — survey the team, close knowledge gaps, and report on readiness ahead of launch dates

**Use Case Program**

* Ensure use cases are coherent, GTM-ready, and accessible across Sales teams, Marketing, and CS as functional tools, not just internal documentation
* Partner with Product Operations on the technical infrastructure required to support use case creation, storage, and distribution
* Establish a feedback loop so field input on use case quality and coverage is systematically captured and routed back to the product team

**Cross-Functional Alignment & Roadmap Governance**

* Run a regular Product-GTM sync cadence — bringing Product, Product Marketing, Sales leadership, and CS together around launch calendars, roadmap updates, and in-flight priorities
* Maintain a shared GTM launch calendar visible to all stakeholders, with status, ownership, and readiness signals for every active initiative

IT Project Manager (Healthcare IT)
==================================

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **FLSA Status:** Exempt
* **Department:** Operations – Project Management Office (PMO)
* **Work Location:** Remote - U.S.

Position Summary 
**The Project Manager leads client-facing IT infrastructure and managed services projects from initiation through closure. This role translates technical scope into practical project plans, coordinates technical teams, vendors, procurement, and client stakeholders, and keeps projects aligned with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. By delivering organized, proactive project leadership, this position strengthens the client experience, supports timely delivery and revenue, and expands the Project Management Office’s capacity.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of client-facing IT projects, including managed services onboardings, migrations, offboardings, infrastructure implementations, cybersecurity deployments, hardware refreshes, and environment upgrades.
* Review statements of work, technical requirements, budgets, dependencies, and resource needs to confirm delivery readiness before kickoff.
* Develop clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, go-live checkpoints, and transition-to-support activities.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects while monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, labor hours, documentation, client commitments, and hardware or vendor dependencies.
* Lead client-facing and internal project meetings, communicate status and decisions, and ensure required actions are completed.
* Coordinate engineers, technical leads, Procurement, Account Management, Sales, vendors, and client stakeholders across interdependent workstreams.
* Identify risks, scope changes, blockers, and conflicting requirements early; recommend solutions and escalate decisions when needed.
* Validate implementation readiness, quality assurance, client acceptance, billing milestones, and closure criteria.
* Maintain accurate project records and status updates in project management systems and contribute to process improvements and lessons learned.
* Build trusted relationships while setting clear expectations, holding owners accountable, and maintaining a confident, solutions-oriented approach.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least four years of experience managing client-facing IT infrastructure or managed services projects in an MSP, technology services provider, consulting organization, or similarly complex customer-facing environment.
* Experience leading projects involving several of the following: networking, servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, identity and access, cybersecurity, migrations, hardware deployment, site readiness, or IT environment assessments.
* Ability to interpret statements of work, technical requirements, and solution documentation and turn them into actionable delivery plans.
* Strong knowledge of project controls, including scope, schedule, budget, resource planning, risk and issue management, acceptance criteria, and go-live readiness.
* Experience coordinating technical resources, vendors, procurement, account teams, and clients across resource-constrained, interdependent workstreams.
* Proven ability to identify technical and operational risks, resolve ambiguity, manage scope changes, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to facilitate technical discussions, hold owners accountable, and present concise updates to clients and leadership.
* Proficiency with project management platforms and Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience supporting healthcare, senior care, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Jira, GuideCX, or a comparable project management platform.
* PMP, CAPM, CompTIA Project+, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or another relevant project management or technical certification.
* Experience managing a high-volume project portfolio in a resource-constrained environment.

What Success Looks Like 
**A high-performing Project Manager keeps a complex portfolio moving with clear plans, accurate documentation, proactive risk management, and consistent follow-through. Success is demonstrated through confident client communication, strong accountability across technical and cross-functional teams, timely and effective project delivery, and a positive impact on client satisfaction, team capacity, and business performance.**

**POSITION TITLE:** Clinical Operations Manager

**DEPARTMENT:** Monitoring

**Ora Values the Daily Practice of …**

*Prioritizing Kindness \* Operational Excellence \* Cultivating Joy \* Scientific Rigor*

  

At Ora, we are building the future of ophthalmic clinical research. As the world's leading full-service ophthalmic drug and device development firm, we guide our clients across all phases of clinical research to efficiently bring new products and therapies to market. Over the past 45 years, our expert teams have helped earn more than 85 new product approvals. Ora's pre-clinical and clinical models, unique methodologies, integrated clinical data solutions, and global regulatory strategies have been refined and proven across thousands of global projects.Today, our team continues to expand across the globe, with over 600 employees across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America.

**The Role:**

The Clinical Operations Manager is a key operational leader within the Clinical Monitoring organization, responsible for overseeing and optimizing Clinical Trial Associate (CTA) support activities across Ora clinical studies. This role serves as a liaison between CTA teams, CRAs, Project Managers and Clinical Operations leadership to ensure efficient, compliant and high-quality trial execution.

The role provides operational leadership, mentorship, training, process oversight, resource coordination and continuous improvement support for CTA activities while driving operational excellence and inspection readiness.

**What You'll Do:**

**Clinical Trial Associate Operational Leadership**

* Serve as the operational lead and subject matter expert for CTA functions within the Clinical Monitoring organization.
* Partner with Leadership to implement operational strategies, departmental objectives and process improvements.
* Oversee resource forecasting and workload assessments for the CTA group
* Provide functional leadership, guidance, mentoring and day-to-day support to CTA staff.
* Support onboarding, training and professional development initiatives for CTAs.
* Approve time reporting and expenses for direct reports
* Act as an escalation point for CTA operational issues and collaborate with Monitoring leadership to resolve challenges.

**Monitoring Operations Support**

* Partner with Project Managers, CTMs and CRAs to ensure CTA activities support project plans and study timelines.
* Monitor CTA-related performance metrics and operational indicators.
* Support inspection readiness and audit preparedness activities.
* Provide operational oversight of CTA deliverables to ensure quality and compliance.

**Process Excellence and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead initiatives focused on standardization, optimization, automation and continuous improvement.
* Support development and maintenance of SOPs, work instructions, training materials and operational tools.
* Promote effective utilization of CTMS, eTMF and other clinical technologies.
* Identify operational risks and recommend solutions.

**Study Oversight and Compliance**

* Oversee CTA support activities related to study startup, maintenance and closeout.
* Ensure study documentation and TMF activities remain complete and inspection-ready.
* Support compliance with sponsor requirements, SOPs, ICH-GCP guidelines and regulations.

  + Minimum of 1 year of management or leadership experience, preferably in a CRO setting

  + Proven ability to lead multifunctional teams and manage and mentor junior clinical operations staff.
  + Prior CRO experience is strongly preferred
  + Ability to motivate and lead / mentor a team and identify and execution coaching opportunities
  + Understanding of comprehensive regulatory requirements and implications for clinical operations.
  + Experience managing external partnerships and relations (e.g., sites, vendors, sponsors).

#### **Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager is responsible for providing operational leadership and oversight across Nationwide Auto Services project operations. This position leads and supports NAS Operations Managers and Field Teams responsible for Overspray, Workforce Solutions, Automotive Services, and Agriculture Equipment / High and Heavy projects.

The Senior Operations Project Manager serves as the primary operational link between NAS leadership, Project Managers, field teams, and customers. The role is accountable for ensuring projects are properly planned, staffed, launched, executed, measured, and closed while meeting customer requirements, safety standards, quality expectations, financial targets, and contractual obligations.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can manage multiple projects, Operations Managers, and Field Teams across different locations and service lines while maintaining consistent NAS operating standards.

Key Responsibilities

#### **Project Management Leadership**

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to NAS Operations Managers across assigned projects and service lines.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, responsibilities, and performance standards for Operations Managers.
* Conduct regular project reviews covering staffing, productivity, safety, quality, schedule, customer requirements, financial performance, and open risks.
* Support Operations Managers and Field Supervisors with issue resolution, resource planning, customer escalations, and operational decisionmaking.
* Ensure Operations Managers maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, timekeeping, staffing records, training records, and customer deliverables.
* Develop consistent project management practices and operating standards across NAS locations.

#### **Operational Oversight**

* Overspray Services: Vehicle inspections, contamination assessment, overspray removal, quality verification, production tracking, and customer reporting.
* Workforce Solutions: Staffing programs supporting customer operations, including workforce planning, recruiting coordination, onboarding, scheduling, productivity management, attendance, and performance.
* Automotive Services: Vehicle inspection, repair campaigns, rework, accessory installation, paint and body repair, hail damage repair, yard services, quality campaigns, and other OEM or logisticsrelated services.
* Agriculture Equipment / High and Heavy Services: Inspection, repair, modification, campaign, processing, yard, and related services supporting agricultural, construction, and other high and heavy equipment.

#### **Project Launch and Execution**

* Lead operational planning for new projects from award through implementation.
* Review scopes of work, customer requirements, pricing assumptions, labor models, equipment requirements, schedules, and project milestones before launch.
* Develop project launch plans identifying staffing, leadership, equipment, training, safety requirements, reporting, and customer communication.
* Coordinate with Business Development, Human Resources, Recruiting, Safety, Finance, Quality, and other NAS functions to ensure projects are properly supported.
* Conduct project readiness reviews before startup and stabilization reviews following launch.
* Identify potential operational risks early and develop corrective or contingency plans.

#### **Financial and Performance Management**

* Monitor project performance against approved labor models, budgets, productivity targets, and customer requirements.
* Review labor hours, overtime, staffing levels, utilization, productivity, and other cost drivers.
* Partner with Finance and leadership to identify projects performing outside expected financial targets.
* Work with Operations Managers to develop corrective action plans when operational or financial performance falls below expectations.
* Validate that completed work and supporting documentation are captured accurately and submitted timely for invoicing.

#### **Customer Management**

* Establish strong working relationships with customer operational leadership and key stakeholders.
* Participate in customer business reviews, project meetings, startup meetings, and operational performance discussions.
* Ensure customer concerns and escalations are addressed promptly and communicated to NAS leadership when appropriate.
* Identify additional customer needs or service opportunities and communicate them to Business Development and executive leadership.
* Maintain professional representation of NAS at customer facilities and industry locations.

#### **Safety, Quality and Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture across all assigned projects.
* Ensure field teams comply with NAS safety requirements and customer sitespecific requirements.
* Confirm employees have completed required technical, safety, HR, and customer training before performing assigned work.
* Monitor quality performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented when standards are not met.
* Support incident investigations, corrective actions, root cause reviews, and preventive measures.
* Ensure operations comply with applicable customer contracts, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

#### **Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish consistent reporting standards across assigned projects.
* Provide NAS leadership with regular project status updates covering safety, quality, staffing, productivity, financial performance, customer concerns, risks, and upcoming priorities.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators for Operations Managers, field supervisors, field employees and project operations.
* Identify operational best practices that can be implemented across multiple NAS projects.
* Lead post project reviews and capture lessons learned for future projects.
* Support development of Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, project launch templates,

jobs.title: Operations Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Operations ManagerLead the People, Processes, Systems, and Performance Behind a Growing Immigration Law Firm**

MRA Law Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Operations Manager** to lead the day-to-day performance, accountability, systems coordination, and continuous improvement of our Operations Department.

This is a leadership role for someone who knows how to turn expectations into execution.

The Operations Manager will oversee the operational teams responsible for supporting our clients, attorneys, and case production functions, from the first phone call through ongoing client communication, administrative support, document handling, internal operational requests, and systems-related execution.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, build accountability, analyze performance, improve processes, coordinate systems support, solve problems, and create an Operations Department that runs consistently without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership.

**What You Will Own**

**Operations Leadership & Team Management**

You will provide leadership and accountability across the Operations Department, including:

* Operations Team Lead
* Telephone Receptionist Team Lead and Receptionists
* Client CARE Team Lead and Client CARE Agents
* Virtual Assistant
* In-Office Administrative Assistant
* In-Office Legal Assistant
* Systems Administrator
* Systems Developer

You will establish clear expectations, ensure accountability, coach leaders and team members, identify performance issues early, and ensure the department has the structure, workflows, tools, and resources necessary to perform effectively.

You will be expected to manage both people and execution. This includes ensuring that team leaders are leading, frontline employees are meeting expectations, and systems-related support is helping the firm operate faster, cleaner, and more efficiently.

**Operational Performance & Accountability**

You will:

* Establish, monitor, and manage departmental and individual KPIs.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational performance.
* Hold team leaders accountable for the performance of their respective teams.
* Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring problems, and operational risks.
* Develop corrective action and coaching plans when performance falls below expectations.
* Ensure operational audits are completed and identified issues are addressed.
* Build an environment where ownership, follow-through, and accountability are part of everyday operations.

The current Operations framework measures department efficiency, workflow effectiveness, error reduction, client communication compliance, client satisfaction, complaints, procedure compliance, system usage, documentation accuracy, team KPI achievement, audits, issue-resolution time, process improvement, and operational risk identification.

**Systems, Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

The Operations Manager will play a key leadership role in ensuring the firm’s systems support the way the business actually needs to operate.

You will oversee the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer to ensure that systems, workflows, automations, reports, user access, troubleshooting, and technology improvements are properly prioritized and executed.

You will:

* Ensure operational systems are being used consistently and correctly.
* Translate operational needs into clear systems requirements.
* Coordinate with the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer on workflow improvements, automation opportunities, reporting needs, and system-related issues.
* Ensure system changes are aligned with operational goals and do not create unnecessary disruption.
* Monitor system usage, documentation accuracy, and compliance with required workflows.
* Identify gaps between process design, system capability, and actual team execution.
* Help prioritize technology improvements based on business impact, urgency, and scalability.
* Ensure systems-related projects are completed with clear ownership, timelines, testing, rollout, and follow-through.

This role does not require the Operations Manager to be a programmer. However, it does require someone who can understand operational problems, ask the right questions, manage systems-related priorities, and ensure technology supports performance instead of becoming another bottleneck.

**Client Experience**

Our Operations Department plays a major role in how clients experience MRA Law Group.

You will ensure:

* Client calls and communications are handled professionally and promptly.
* Reception and Client CARE teams consistently meet service expectations.
* Client concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately.
* Communication breakdowns do not become preventable client complaints.
* Operational issues contributing to cancellations, dissatisfaction, or refund exposure are identified and addressed.
* Client feedback and satisfaction trends are monitored and converted into practical operational improvements.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

We do not want someone who simply maintains existing processes. We want someone who asks:

**Why are we doing it this way, is it working, and can we do it better?**

You will:

* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs and workflows.
* Ensure consistent use of the firm’s case management system, trackers, and operational tools.
* Ensure tasks, communications, and activities are properly documented.
* Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, bottlenecks, process gaps, and ownership gaps.
* Translate operational problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Implement improvements and measure whether they actually worked.
* Identify operational risks before they become larger client, legal, financial, or business problems.

The right person for this role will not treat process improvement as theory. You should be able to move from observation to diagnosis, fro

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Commercial Partnership Operations Manager is responsible for executing and managing CallOnDoc's commercial partnership operating process from inbound partner inquiry through executive approval, implementation, onboarding, launch, and ongoing operational success.

Working closely with executive leadership, this role ensures every partnership opportunity is objectively qualified, documented, prioritized, and prepared for executive decision-making before engineering, product, clinical, legal, finance, and operational resources are committed.

Following executive approval, this individual becomes the primary operational owner of the partnership, coordinating internal stakeholders, facilitating implementation, managing partner onboarding, monitoring launch readiness, and serving as the primary operational point of contact for B2B partners.

This is not a sales role, not a quota-carrying business development position, and not a technical project management role. Instead, this position serves as the operational owner of CallOnDoc's B2B partnership lifecycle, ensuring qualified opportunities progress efficiently from intake through launch while maintaining exceptional partner experience and cross-functional execution.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, process-driven, technically fluent, and an exceptional communicator who enjoys coordinating cross-functional teams and building operational excellence.

Primary Areas of Ownership  
1. Partnership Intake & Qualification

Manage the intake and qualification process for all inbound B2B partnership opportunities.

Responsibilities

Review all inbound partnership inquiries.

* Strong client-facing experience, including business reviews and quality-related escalations.
* Strong knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, DMAIC, RCA, CAPA, and continuous improvement; Six Sigma Black Belt preferred.
