jobs.title: Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Health Coach
jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options:

* **Central, Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time:** 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm
* **Eastern Time:** 9am to 6pm ET only

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
* Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
* Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
* Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
* Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

**Who You Are**

* A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.
* Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.
* Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
* Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.
* Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

**What You Need**

* An active NBHWC health coaching certification is required.
* At least 1 year of experience as a health coach is required.
* Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is required.
* Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
* Fluency in Spanish is required.
* Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

**Compensation**

The anticipated salary range for this role is $22 - $26 per hour, which is based on role scope, level, and location. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.

Responsibilities:

**Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.**

* Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
* Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
* Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. *Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.*

**Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.**

* Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
* Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
* Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
* Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. *Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.*

**Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.**

* Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
* Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
* Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. *Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.*
* Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

**Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.**

* Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.

At Tavio, our mission is to eliminate data chaos. But we are not just another lightweight iPaaS. We believe in changing the world by sharing our expertise and enabling teams to work better through modern technology and intelligent automation.

With more than 600 experts across 10 countries, Eficode brings together people from across the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK and the Americas. We’re an Atlassian Platinum Partner, a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA and an Azure Managed Service Provider.

Now, we’re looking for a Growth Account Manager to join our growing US Sales team and help accelerate our growth across new and expanding enterprise accounts.

**Role purpose**

If you’re an ambitious technology sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships and turning customer challenges into commercial opportunities, this could be a great opportunity.

As a Growth Account Manager, you’ll drive pipeline growth across the US through targeted outreach to prospective and expanding enterprise customers. You’ll help organizations navigate the future of software development, from adopting AI across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to building effective developer tooling and platform environments.

Working across Eficode’s portfolio and technology ecosystem - including Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS and Microsoft Azure - you’ll identify opportunities where our consulting, workshops, migrations, managed services and software licensing can make a real difference.

This is a proactive, consultative sales role. You’ll combine a strong hunting mindset with the ability to understand customer challenges, bring in the right technical expertise and develop opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

  

**Role responsibilities**

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

* **Generate new pipeline** through strategic outbound activity and targeted sales campaigns across prospective and existing enterprise accounts.
* **Develop customer relationships**, engaging engineering, DevOps, procurement and business leaders to understand their challenges, priorities and growth plans.
* **Drive AI & SDLC opportunities**, helping customers explore AI readiness, tool adoption, workflow automation, AI agents and governance.
* **Shape tooling and platform conversations**, helping customers simplify fragmented developer toolchains and build effective, reliable platform environments.
* **Grow services and licensing opportunities** across consulting, workshops, migrations, platform acceleration, managed services and software licensing.
* **Partner with our technology ecosystem**, including Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS and Microsoft Azure, alongside Eficode’s internal solution specialists to develop and win opportunities.
* **Grow existing accounts** through cross-sell, upsell, software licence upgrades and renewals, building long-term customer value.
* **Own your pipeline and forecast**, maintaining accurate account plans, opportunities and revenue forecasts within Salesforce.

  

**How you will work**

This role is all about creating momentum - finding opportunities, understanding what matters to customers and connecting them with the right expertise from across Eficode.

* **Proactive:** You’re comfortable creating your own opportunities, opening doors and maintaining momentum even when sales cycles are complex.
* **Consultative:** You seek to understand the customer before selling, connecting their challenges and ambitions with solutions that create genuine value.
* **Commercially minded:** You can identify where services, software and long-term partnerships create value for both the customer and Eficode.
* **Curious:** You’re interested in how AI, DevOps, cloud and developer platforms are changing the way organizations build software.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with Sales, technical specialists, Delivery teams and technology partners to develop and win opportunities.
* **Results-driven:** You take ownership of your pipeline and are motivated by ambitious growth targets and measurable outcomes.

**Role requirements**

**You’ll make a great match for this role if you have:**

* **5+ years of B2B technology sales experience** across business development, account management, SaaS, software or IT professional services.
* **A proven hunting mindset**, with experience generating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and developing new opportunities.
* **A solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle**, DevOps, developer platforms and cloud environments.
* **Familiarity with technology ecosystems** such as Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* **Strong consultative selling and executive communication skills**, with the ability to understand customer challenges and articulate technical value and ROI.
* **Experience selling professional services**, technical workshops, cloud migrations, DevOps consulting or similar technology services.
* **Experience using Salesforce CRM** and modern sales engagement tools.
* **Willingness to travel** across the US for customer meetings and events, with occasional international travel.

**Nice-to-haves**

**It would be an added bonus if you have:**

* Knowledge of how AI is changing software development, including AI coding assistants, agents, automation and AI governance.
* Experience working within the Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS or Microsoft partner ecosystems.
* Experience developing opportunities through vendor co-selling and partner relationships.
* Experience selling a combination of professional services, managed services and software licensing.

**What’s in it for you?**

* The opportunity to play a key role in the continued growth of Eficode’s US bus

jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The **SCN Screener & Care Navigator** is responsible for conducting standardized social needs screenings, engaging members to identify unmet social determinants of health (SDOH), and facilitating referrals and linkages to appropriate community-based services within the Social Care Network (SCN). This role supports members in navigating services related to food insecurity, housing instability, transportation, utilities, and other social needs, while ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with NY Medicaid and SCN requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Screening & Assessment**

* Conduct standardized SCN social needs screenings (e.g., food, housing, utilities, transportation, interpersonal safety, etc.)
* Engage members telephonically and/or in person using trauma-informed and culturally competent approaches
* Identify eligible SCN services and determine appropriate next steps based on screening results
* Explain available social care services and member rights in clear, understandable language

**Care Navigation & Referral Coordination**

* Initiate and coordinate referrals to approved SCN vendors and community-based organizations
* Support members in completing referrals and overcoming barriers to service access
* Track referral outcomes and follow up to ensure services are initiated and completed
* Coordinate with care managers, health plans, and SCN partners as needed

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred in human services, social work, public health, or related field)
* Experience conducting screenings, outreach, or care coordination in healthcare, social services, or community-based settings
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to engage diverse populations with sensitivity and professionalism
* Proficiency with electronic documentation systems and basic computer applications

We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

**Who We Are**

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

**Event Operations Coordinator - POSSIBLE**  
  
**A bit about us**  
We’re Hyve - organizer of the world’s fastest-growing and most forward-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies - helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth and connect with the people who matter most.
  
  
Our portfolio features some of the world’s leading events in sectors like ecommerce, healthcare, edtech, and fintech. We’re growing fast with an entrepreneurial culture that empowers big ideas and quick action, plus an ambitious acquisition strategy bringing exciting new events into our mix.
  
  
Alongside our market-leading events, we’re building tech and data-driven products that supercharge connections – from one-to-one meeting programs and curated table talks to year-round engagement platforms. * Attend vendor and partner meetings, capturing detailed notes and tracking action items.
* Monitor vendor deliverables, contracts, deadlines, and key operational milestones.
* Assist with vendor onboarding, processing purchase orders, and payment tracking.

**Accommodation & Registration Support**  

* Assist with hotel room block management and housing platform administration.
* Monitor booking activity and support reporting related to room pickup and attrition.
* Support registration-related initiatives as needed.

**Event Experience & Onsite Operations**  

* Support the delivery of attendee experiences, catering programs, networking events, and special activations.
* Assist with onsite event office setup, inventory management, staff coordination, and logistical execution.
* Serve as a key onsite team member, helping troubleshoot issues and ensure a seamless event experience.

**Documentation & Reporting**  

* Maintain operational documents, floorplans, run-of-show materials, staffing schedules, and event checklists.
* Assist with post-event reporting, compiling operational insights, lessons learned, and recommendations to support future planning.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Partner closely with internal teams, including Marketing, Sales, Content, Registration, and Customer Success, to ensure seamless event execution.
* Participate in planning meetings and provide operational updates to stakeholders.
* Support process improvements and contribute ideas to enhance operational efficiency and the attendee experience.

* A minimum of 3 years' experience in event operations, event coordination, hospitality, conferences, exhibitions, meetings, or related fields.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Build a career powered by innovations that matter!** At Novanta, our innovations power technology products that are transforming healthcare and advanced manufacturing—improving productivity, enhancing people’s lives and redefining what’s possible. We create for our global customers engineered components and sub-systems that deliver extreme precision and performance for a range of mission-critical applications—from minimally invasive surgery to robotics to 3D metal printing.

Novanta is one global team with over 26 offices located in The Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Looking for a great place to work? You have found it with a culture that embraces teamwork, collaboration and empowerment. Come explore Novanta.

  

**Summary**

  

As a Key Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving strategic growth for Novanta's Precision Medicine business. This is an opportunity to partner with some of the world's leading OEMs, uncover new market opportunities, influence product roadmaps, and help bring innovative technologies to life.

  

In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customers while connecting voice-of-customer insights to Novanta's commercial and product strategies. You will build executive-level relationships, identify whitespace opportunities, and translate complex customer challenges into scalable solutions that drive long-term growth.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* **Drive Strategic Account Growth** by expanding relationships within key OEM accounts, identifying whitespace opportunities, and developing account strategies that accelerate revenue, market share, and long-term customer value.
* **Uncover and Convert New Opportunities** through consultative customer engagement, translating workflow challenges, unmet needs, and voice-of-customer insights into qualified opportunities, project wins, and scalable production programs.
* **Influence Customer and Business Strategy** by building trusted relationships with engineering, procurement, quality, commercial, and executive stakeholders while connecting customer needs to Novanta's product and technology roadmap.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Execution** by partnering with commercial, engineering, operations, product management, and program teams to deliver customer solutions, drive account success, and support profitable growth.

  

**Required Experience, Education, Skills, Training and Competencies**

* **Strategic Commercial Leadership:** Proven success growing complex OEM or B2B accounts through consultative selling, opportunity creation, account planning, and pipeline development.
* **Customer-Centric Problem Solving:** Ability to uncover customer challenges, identify growth opportunities, and translate technical, operational, and commercial needs into actionable business solutions.
* **Executive Influence and Relationship Building:** Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels, from engineers and procurement teams to senior executives.
* **Business Acumen and Execution Excellence:** Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills with experience leveraging CRM tools, customer insights, and business data to drive decisions, forecast opportunities, and achieve results.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a desk.
* Ability to lift, carry, and transport demonstration equipment and related materials up to 25 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Manual dexterity for using a computer, including typing and operating a mouse.
Stamina for frequent travel, including long flights and car rides.  

  

**Travel Requirements**

* Expect to travel up to 50% of the time, including overnight stays.
* Ability to travel on short notice and adapt to changing schedules.
Must have a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.  

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

* The base pay for this position is $122,000 to $183,800 per year depending on the geographic market.
* This position provides an opportunity for competitive quarterly sales compensation based on an achievement to plan.
Novanta supports all aspects of your life's needs. This position provides a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits to make your quality of life better.  

  

**Why Novanta?**

At Novanta, we're united by a shared mission to deliver innovation that matters. Our technologies enable breakthroughs in healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and robotics, helping customers solve complex challenges around the world.

  

As part of Precision Medicine's Positioning Solutions business, you will connect customer insight, commercial strategy, and product innovation to help transform customer challenges into meaningful solutions, project wins, and long-term production programs.

  

If you're energized by building strategic relationships, creating growth opportunities, influencing product direction, and helping customers succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Novanta is proud to be an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, military and veteran status, disability, genetics, or any other category protected by federal law or Novanta policy.

Please call +1 781-266-5700 if you need a disability accommodation for any part of the employment process.

jobs.title: Sales Training Manager
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

The Monogram Sales & Clinical Training Manager will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing a comprehensive sales and clinical training program focused on supporting orthopedic robotics solutions. As a subject matter and technical expert, this role ensures that sales representatives and clinical specialists are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to effectively promote and support robotic-assisted orthopedic procedures. The Monogram Sales & Clinical Training Manager will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Medical Education, and R&D teams to deliver best-in-class training experiences that drive adoption and customer satisfaction.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* **Program Development**
  + Create a structured training curriculum for sales representatives and clinical teams, covering product knowledge, surgical workflows, and robotics technology.
  + Develop blended learning solutions (e-learning, in-person workshops, virtual sessions) to maximize engagement and retention.
  + Identify technology to scale training execution (eg. AI training tools)
  + Ensure training content aligns with regulatory requirements and company standards.
* **Execution & Delivery**
  + Manage end-to-end training program rollout, including scheduling, logistics, and resource allocation.
  + Facilitate live training sessions and workshops as needed.
  + Create scalable LMS resources to ensure program success & easy access resources.
  + Implement standardized assessment tools and results tracking to measure competency and program effectiveness.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration**
  + Partner with Sales Leadership to identify skill gaps and training priorities
  + Provide timely virtual and practical clinical support to sales team members requiring assistance for product knowledge cases or troubleshooting
  + Work closely with Clinical Education, MRX team and R&D to ensure technical accuracy and relevance.
  + Coordinate with Marketing & Medical Education for consistent messaging, quality of clinical content and branding of materials
* **Continuous Improvement**
  + Gain hands on experience, become a product expert and continuously upskill self to facilitate high quality teaching
  + Monitor program performance through feedback, metrics, and adoption rates.
  + Update training content based on product enhancements, market trends, and user feedback.
  + Stay current on orthopedic robotics advancements and best practices in adult learning.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Strong understanding of orthopedic surgical procedures and/or robotics technology.
* Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs.
* Excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder management skills.

**Your Background**
-------------------

* **Minimum Requirements:** Bachelor's Degree and 4 years of relevant experience, or Associate's Degree and 6 years of relevant experience, or High School Diploma or Equivalent and 8 years of relevant experience
* **Preferred Experience/Education:**
  + Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Healthcare, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  + 5+ years of experience in program management, training development, or sales enablement within medical devices or healthcare.
  + Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital training tools.
  + Certification in instructional design or adult learning principles.
  + Familiarity with regulatory compliance in medical device training.
  + Deep understanding and/or experience with competitive CT robotic systems.

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

Ability to travel up to 40%, as required.

**Expected Compensation Range**
-------------------------------

$125,000 - $157,000 USD/annual

Red Nucleus is seeking a Senior Instructional Designer to join our L&D team, with expertise in designing and developing engaging instructor-led and virtual workshop experiences. This individual will partner with clients, stakeholders, and subject matter experts to create learning solutions that drive knowledge, skill development, and behavior change.

**About Red Nucleus**

Our purpose is advancing knowledge to improve lives.
  
We succeed by being the premier provider of strategic learning and development, scientific advisory services, and medical communications solutions for the life sciences industry.

  

Within our L&D team, w e work with life sciences companies of all sizes, from those bringing their first product to market to the largest multinational firms. This role will primarily service clients in the oncology space , supporting sales reps, HCPs, MSLs, and other commercial roles.

**About This Role**

The Senior Instructional Designer role lead s the design and writing of interactive, engaging, and creative learning solutions for life sciences industry professionals, across a number of modalities including live and virtual workshops.

This individual will translate client goals, objectives , and strategy into effective learning experiences for target learners. Every day is different and can range from performing curriculum
  
analyses and developing measurement strategies to designing specific deliverables that leverage blended approaches.

* Demonstrated experience in needs analysis, instructional design, curriculum development, learning measurement, and adult learning methodologies

* Experience designing live and virtual instructor-led workshops and learning experiences

* Ability to translate complex content into impactful learning experiences

* Comfortable with AI tools, MS Office, and virtual meeting platforms

* Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, and organizational skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced client environment

* Knowledge of and experience within the life sciences industry, such as

jobs.title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a Senior Technical Business Analyst to serve as a strategic partner between business and technology, leading complex initiatives from concept through delivery. In this role, you’ll translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, analyze complex systems and data, and help drive decisions across critical applications and integrations.

You’ll serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, partnering across business, development, architecture, data, and infrastructure teams to solve complex problems and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business strategy.

**Essential Functions**

* Lead the analysis and documentation of complex business and technical requirements, translating business needs into comprehensive functional and technical specifications for enterprise systems, enhancements, and integrations.
* Serve as a thought partner to business and technology leaders by evaluating solution options, identifying dependencies and trade-offs, and recommending approaches that balance scalability, performance, risk, cost, and business needs.
* Use advanced SQL, backend data analysis, and application and database logs to validate system behavior, investigate complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and support defect resolution across production and non-production environments.
* Serve as a senior technical liaison between business stakeholders, development, architecture, data, and infrastructure teams to establish a shared understanding of requirements, system behavior, data flows, and technical dependencies.
* Lead analysis and ongoing support of complex system integrations, including APIs, event-driven architectures, file-based interfaces, middleware, ETL processes, and data exchanges between internal and third-party systems.
* Perform comprehensive impact and dependency analysis for proposed system, integration, and data changes, identifying downstream effects across applications, platforms, integrations, processes, and reporting.

jobs.title: Paralegal and Case Manager - Personal Injury
jobs.description:
**About the Firm**

We will be a new West Virginia personal injury firm built on a simple premise: West Virginians injured deserve high caliber representation.

We are a velocity practice. We resolve cases at fair value, and when carriers refuse to make reasonable offers, we file. We are deliberately disciplined about case selection, deadline management, and client communication. The work product we deliver to courts, opposing counsel, and adjusters is held to the highest standard.

The firm's founding attorney is admitted in West Virginia, Virginia, and the District of Columbia and has been in active practice since 2007.

**What You'll Do**

During the launch ramp (months 1 through 6):

* Conduct detailed client intake and onboarding within 3 days of a signed fee agreement
* Track each client's medical treatment trajectory through Maximum Medical Improvement
* Maintain client communication on the firm's published cadence: biweekly status calls during stable treatment, weekly during active treatment, monthly during quiescent periods
* Order and organize medical records and bills as treatment progresses, not at the end
* Identify and track liens, subrogation claims, and reimbursement obligations (W.Va. Medicaid under § 9-5-11, Medicare MSP, ERISA self-funded plans, PEIA, hospital balances, LOP holders)
* Draft demand packages for attorney review and approval
* Run post-demand negotiation under attorney direction
* Coordinate disbursement and lien resolution on settled matters
* Help build and refine internal SOPs, intake checklists, and demand templates as the firm scales

**As the litigation track populates (month 6 forward):**

* Draft pleadings, discovery, and motions under attorney supervision
* Calendar all scheduling order deadlines under W.Va. Rule 16(b)(3) with redundant reminders
* Manage Rule 26(a)(1) initial disclosures, the Rule 26(f) conference and 14-day report, and discovery exchange under the 2025 amendments
* Coordinate depositions, exhibit and witness exchange, and trial logistics
* Track court deadlines, hearings, and trial dates
* Coordinate with local counsel in distant counties when in-person appearances are required

**Cross-cutting throughout:**

* Carry a target caseload of no fewer than 50 active matters once the firm is ramped (typically by month 5 to 6); your starting caseload will be smaller and grows with the firm
* Participate in monthly two-eyes statute of limitations reviews on every active matter
* File weekly status reports
* Surface operational gaps and undocumented procedures - we improve continuously

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of West Virginia plaintiff personal injury experience. This is firm. Out-of-state PI experience does not substitute for West Virginia experience, because the procedure, statutes, and local court culture are specific.
* Demonstrated current working knowledge of the 2025 West Virginia Rules of Civil Procedure amendments, including Rule 4 service revisions, the Rule 26 federalized discovery framework, Rule 30(d) deposition limits, and the Rule 6(d) motion briefing windows
* Working knowledge of West Virginia Magistrate Court procedure under the post-2025 $20,000 jurisdictional cap, including Rule 13 discovery limits and the Rule 18 / W.Va. Code § 50-5-12 appeal framework
* Demonstrated ability to draft demand packages, calculate special damages, and negotiate routine adjuster matters
* Demonstrated lien and subrogation experience: Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, PEIA, hospital, and LOP
* Familiarity with W.Va. Code § 55-17-3 pre-suit notice requirements for state agency defendants and the broader pre-suit notice landscape for public defendants
* Comfort with statewide e-filing through the WV E-File / CourtPLUS system, mandatory in all 55 counties under TCR 15A
* Ability to manage a 40+ matter caseload without dropping deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience at a high-volume plaintiff PI firm
* Prior supervisory experience. As one of the first hires at a new firm, you will be a model and mentor for paralegal and case manager hires that follow you. Candidates who have run or trained junior staff are preferred.
* Prior trial support experience (exhibit preparation, witness coordination, trial-day logistics)
* Familiarity with the West Virginia Wrongful Death Act and minor-settlement approval procedures under W.Va. Code § 44-10-14

**What We Look For Beyond the Resume**

* Self-direction. You are joining a remote, brand-new firm. There is no team to lean on for the first several months. You need to be able to produce strong work without persistent in-person supervision.
* Velocity. You treat deadlines as binding and move every case forward every month.
* Ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
* Discipline. You follow documented procedures, file your weekly report on time, and surface operational issues rather than working around them.
* Care. Our clients are real people in pain. They are not files.

**Working Here**

* Fully remote. No commute. No central office requirement. We operate statewide.
* Modern stack. Cloud case management software, mandatory MFA, full-disk encryption, and firm-issued or firm-approved equipment.
* Quiet location, computer to yourself, no distractions. *All remote workers require standard monitoring software installed on either company computers or a private user account on their personal computer.*
* Real growth. Clear advancement path to Lead Paralegal as the firm's volume expands and additional paralegal and case manager hires come on board.

Pay: $53,000.00 - $74,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

new_jobs.title: Farm School Teacher and Program Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Ray of Sunshine Farm is looking for an energetic, organized and entrepreneurial Farm School Teacher & Program Coordinator to take ownership of our children's farm education program.

This is more than a teaching position. We're looking for someone who loves kids, loves nature and animals and can run the program from end to end, from helping get the word out, managing registration and communication with families, teaching our prepared curriculum or developing your own, and then delivering a wonderfuland memorable hands-on experience at the farm.

Our parent/guardian accompanied farm classes introduce young children to animals, gardening, food and agriculture through real experiences: feeding animals, collecting eggs, planting seeds, harvesting vegetables, exploring the garden, and learning about life on a working farm.

The role:

Teaching & program delivery

* Lead engaging, age-appropriate classes for young children
* Teach through hands-on experiences with our animals, gardens and crops
* Follow and improve existing lesson plans and develop new activities over time
* Lead songs, crafts and farm activities
* Confidently manage groups of children while maintaining appropriate safety rules
* Create a warm, welcoming experience for children and their parents/caregivers
* Prepare materials before class and reset/clean up afterward

Program management & administration

* Own the class calendar and coordinate upcoming sessions
* Set up and maintain classes and registration on our website
* Monitor enrollment and manage class rosters
* Communicate with registered families before and after classes
* Answer routine questions from prospective families
* Manage cancellations, transfers, waitlists and other registration details
* Track enrollment and identify classes that need additional promotion
* Maintain supplies and anticipate what will be needed for upcoming classes

Marketing & enrollment

* Help keep classes full by actively promoting upcoming programs
* Create and post class announcements on appropriate local and social media channels
* Help with email/newsletter and social-media promotion
* Reach out to local parent groups, preschools, schools and community organizations
* Develop relationships that can generate repeat enrollment and referrals
* Look for new opportunities to grow the program, including new class ideas, age groups, special events and seasonal programs

Who we're looking for:

This position would be a great fit for someone who combines a natural ability with children with strong organization and initiative.

You don't need to arrive knowing everything about farming. We can teach you about our animals, gardens and farm routines. It's much harder to teach someone how to engage a group of young children, communicate well with parents, stay on top of administrative details and take genuine ownership of a program.

Experience in preschool or elementary education, outdoor education, children's programming, camps, recreation programs, nature education, program coordination or a similar field would be valuable.

We're especially interested in someone who:

* Loves working with young children
* Is warm and engaging while still comfortable being in charge
* Is extremely reliable and organized
* Communicates professionally with parents
* Is comfortable using websites, email, social media and online registration tools
* Doesn't need to be told every small thing that needs to happen
* Enjoys building something and thinking about how to make it better
* Is comfortable outdoors, around animals and getting dirty

What success looks like:

A successful person in this role isn't just someone who teaches a great class. The whole program runs well because they own it and they are looking to grow with the farm!

Families know what's happening. Registration is accurate. Classes are promoted early enough to fill. Materials are ready. Parents get their questions answered. Classes start on time. Children have a great experience. And after each session, you're already thinking about how to make the next one even better.

About Ray of Sunshine Farm

Ray of Sunshine Farm is a small working farm in San Jose's Almaden Valley. We grow fruits and vegetables, raise a variety of farm animals, and create opportunities for families and children to experience agriculture firsthand.

Our farm school isn't intended to recreate a classroom outdoors. We want children to touch, explore, participate, ask questions and develop a real connection with each other, the animals, plants, food and the natural world.

**Schedule:** Part-time and flexible; combination of scheduled classes and flexible administrative hours

Pay: $28.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

* Supporting behavioral health coordination, Substance Abuse and Community Resources.

* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**About DoorDash**

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

**Accenture Flex** offers you the flexibility of local fixed-duration project-based work powered by Accenture, a leading global professional services company. Accenture is consistently recognized on FORTUNE's 100 Best Companies to Work For and Diversity Inc's Top 50 Companies For Diversity lists.

As an **Accenture Flex** employee, you will apply your skills and experience to help drive business transformation for leading organizations and communities. In addition to delivering innovative solutions for Accenture's clients, you will work with a highly skilled, diverse network of people across Accenture businesses who are using the latest emerging technologies to address today's biggest business challenges.

You will receive competitive rewards and access to benefits programs and world-class learning resources. **Accenture Flex** employees work in their local metro area onsite at the project, significantly reducing and/or eliminating the demands to travel.

The Program Manager will serves as the day to day owner and coordinator for client energy activity data the Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 energy datasets that feed the company greenhouse gas GHG inventory emissions forecasting and voluntary and regulatory disclosures. This is a hands on data centric role it requires 3 to 5 years of experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast paced matrixed environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

Serve as the day to day owner for client energy activity data across Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 electricity eg FERA construction energy network related electricity and operational electricity diesel natural gas etc from data collection and QA QC through to the reporting handoff to the Net Zero team.  
  
Perform analyses on Meta Environmental Attribute Certificate EAC portfolio and support the development of internal systems to advance portfolio management and modeling.  
  
Run and maintain the recurring data collection QA QC and validation cadence eg quarterly data pulls follow ups YoY analysis and keeping reporting and analysis on schedule.  
  
Perform and QC data pulls from client energy data systems investigate anomalies and data pipeline issues and reconcile discrepancies.  
  
Coordinate data and process flows across cross functional partners to maintain accurate and complete inputs from source through to reporting.  
  
Support the emissions forecasting cadence as the energy data point of contact for the Net Zero team providing and QAing the activity data behind regulatory and internal cross functional forecasts.  
  
Develop and maintain program management artifacts trackers roadmaps status reports and executive ready updates for recurring leadership and cross functional forums.  
  
Support a quarterly reporting cadence execution updates exec meeting prep deck and dashboard creation using established templates and inputs.  
  
Support external assurance and audit activities eg methodology walkthroughs with Meta assurance provider and preparing and validating data and documentation as requested.  
  
Triage and respond to incoming energy data and analytical requests track progress against internal KPIs and stakeholder expectations.  
  
Maintain and improve reporting documentation the what when where how and why of energy data collection including team specific nuances and process flows.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Minimum 7 years of experience with at least 3 years of direct hands on experience working with large datasets collecting QA QCing reconciling and analyzing data from multiple sources

  

* Familiarity with corporate GHG emissions accounting concepts Scope 1, 2 and 3 and the activity data that underpins an emissions inventory

  

* Exceptional project management skills with a demonstrated ability to self manage complex data driven delivery in a fast paced matrixed environment

  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting data and insights to technical and nontechnical audiences and creating graphics for leadership presentations

  

* High level proficiency in Google Sheets Excel advanced formulas pivot tables and charts plus slide deck creation

  

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data work even under tight deadlines

  

* High School Diploma or GED

new_jobs.description:
**\*\*To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future.**

**SavvyMoney** is a leading San Francisco East Bay fintech company. We provide integrated credit score and personal finance solutions to 1,600 + bank and credit union partners nationally. The SavvyMoney solutions integrate with more than 43 digital banking platforms.

**SavvyMoney was recently recognized by the San Francisco Business Times and the Silicon Valley Journal as one of the "Top 25 Places to Work in the San Francisco Bay Area" and is an Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Company.**

We pride ourselves on a culture of collaboration, innovation, and mutual respect, a team that supports each other’s growth, celebrates successes, and genuinely enjoys the work we do.  
  
**\*\*Our corporate offices are located in Dublin, CA. We offer a flexible/hybrid work environment with some days at the corporate offices and some days working from home.**

As SavvyMoney’s product portfolio continues to grow, successful launches require more than strong products. They require clear processes, cross-functional alignment, operational readiness, and consistent execution.

We are seeking a highly organized and collaborative **Program Manager, Product Marketing** to serve as the operational backbone connecting Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Partner Success. Reporting to the Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will lead the programs and processes that move new products and enhancements from the roadmap through pilot, launch, and general availability.

This role will be responsible for creating structure across complex, cross-functional initiatives, improving how teams work together, and continuously strengthening our launch and go-to-market processes. Success means helping SavvyMoney bring products to market efficiently, ensuring internal teams and partners are prepared, and creating repeatable processes that support our continued growth.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Product & Product Marketing Alignment:** Serve as the primary liaison between Product Marketing and Product Owners, translating product roadmaps, priorities, and release schedules into actionable launch plans. Ensure Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Partner Success have clear visibility into priorities, dependencies, timing, and launch requirements.

**Program & Launch Management:** Lead cross-functional coordination for product launches and enhancements from planning through general availability. Develop and manage project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables, facilitate readiness meetings, proactively identify and escalate risks, and drive accountability to keep launches on track.

**Pilot Program Management:** Plan, coordinate, and oversee pilot programs for new products and enhancements. Partner with Product Owners and Partner Management to identify pilot participants, establish objectives and success criteria, manage communications and timelines, collect feedback, track results, and provide recommendations to support broader product releases.

**Cross-Functional Readiness:** Drive organizational readiness across Product Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, Operations, and other stakeholder groups. Coordinate launch checklists, release documentation, communication plans, training needs, and internal readiness activities to ensure teams understand what is launching, when it is launching, and what is required to support it successfully.

**Project Governance & Process Improvement:** Establish and maintain project governance standards, documentation, templates, and repeatable processes that improve launch execution, increase operational efficiency, and strengthen collaboration between Product and Product Marketing. Continuously identify opportunities to optimize workflows and improve cross-functional communication. Utilize project management and collaboration platforms, including Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, and similar tools, to maintain documentation, track progress, manage risks and dependencies, and provide visibility across multiple concurrent initiatives.

**Stakeholder Communication:** Provide clear and consistent communication throughout the product development and launch process. Deliver regular project updates, document key decisions, track action items, surface risks and dependencies, and ensure stakeholders and leadership have the information needed to make timely decisions.

**Performance Measurement & Reporting:** Define and monitor measures of program and launch success, including launch readiness, milestone completion, pilot outcomes, time-to-market, internal readiness, partner adoption, and other relevant operational metrics. Develop reports and dashboards that provide Product Marketing leadership with visibility into program health, launch performance, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Build trusted relationships across Product Management, Product Marketing, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Partner Success. Bring strong organizational, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills to align diverse teams around shared objectives and drive successful product launches.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

A successful Program Manager will help SavvyMoney:

* Deliver product launches and enhancements on schedule with clear ownership and fewer last-minute gaps.
* Improve visibility into launch status, risks, dependencies, and readiness across teams.
* Establish consistent and repeatable launch and pilot processes that can scale as the product portfolio grows.
* Increase internal and partner readiness for new products and enhancements.
* Turn pilot feedback and launch performance data into actionable recommendations.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Garage Door Installation Project Manager to lead and oversee complex garage door installation projects from inception to completion. This role requires a proactive leader with strong construction management skills, exceptional project coordination abilities, and a passion for delivering high-quality results. As a key driver of project success, you will manage teams, coordinate schedules, ensure regulatory compliance, and maintain budgets—all while fostering a safety-first environment. Join us to contribute your expertise in managing installation projects that enhance residential and commercial properties with precision and efficiency.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of garage door installation projects, ensuring timely delivery within scope and budget.
* Manage project teams including subcontractors, technicians, and vendors to ensure seamless coordination and high performance.
* Develop detailed project plans utilizing construction management software such as ProCore, Primavera P6, or similar tools to track progress and milestones.
* Oversee construction site activities, ensuring adherence to safety protocols, building codes, and regulatory standards.
* Review construction plans, blueprints, and specifications to verify accuracy and feasibility before implementation.
* Monitor project costs through effective cost management strategies, including budgeting, change order processing, and resource allocation.
* Coordinate with clients, architects, engineers, and internal teams to communicate project status updates and resolve issues promptly.
* Ensure compliance with all construction regulations and environmental standards throughout the project lifecycle.
* Utilize construction estimating tools like HeavyBid or Civil 3D for accurate resource planning and cost forecasting.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including contracts, schedules, change orders, and progress reports for audit purposes.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience managing complex infrastructure or commercial construction projects with a focus on installation or specialty trades such as garage doors.
* Strong proficiency in construction management software including ProCore, Bluebeam, Primavera P6 (Primavera), Prolog, Civil 3D, HeavyBid, or equivalent platforms.
* Extensive knowledge of construction scheduling techniques and project timeline coordination.
* Demonstrated ability to manage teams effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high safety standards.
* Solid understanding of construction regulations, building codes, permits, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Excellent blueprint reading skills coupled with the ability to interpret technical drawings accurately.
* Experience in contract management, cost control strategies, and budget oversight for large-scale projects.
* Strong organizational skills with effective time management capabilities to prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Construction site experience combined with excellent communication skills for clear stakeholder engagement.

Join our team as a Garage Door Installation Project Manager if you’re ready to lead impactful projects with energy and precision! Your expertise will help us deliver outstanding results while advancing your career in a thriving construction environment committed to excellence.

**What you will do**
====================

Under general direction from the Installation/Operations Manager and/or Project Manager, you will be responsible for the profitable execution of assigned small dollar Fire Install Projects. Collaborate with Sales, Operations Leadership, and other teams as needed to provide sales support activities early in the project development process, offering input on strategy, vendor/partner selection, scope enhancements, value engineering, risk assessment, and more.

You will provide work direction to project execution teams that may include Engineers, Designers, Technicians, Project Coordinators, Estimators, and Subcontractors, ensuring that assigned projects are completed accurately, on-time, billed, within budget, and within the scope of the contract. You will also be responsible for maintaining positive cash flow and actively pursuing change orders.

Ensure that work performed complies with state, local, and Federal legal requirements while upholding the highest ethical standards. You will adhere to and ensure that Johnson Controls staff and subcontractors adhere to all safety standards, following consistent and repeatable project management procedures and processes. Maintain an effective balance between customer satisfaction and project financial results.

* Build and mature our GxP quality management system: SOPs, document control and training records

**Who you are**

* A hands-on quality lead who builds proportionate, risk-based systems from the ground up

**Requirements**

* Hands-on clinical quality (GCP) experience, not only GMP, plus a working knowledge of GMP

* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area or London, or remote with regular site visits

new_jobs.description:
Cytokinetics is a specialty cardiovascular biopharmaceutical company, building on its over 25 years of pioneering scientific innovations in muscle biology, and advancing a pipeline of potential new medicines for patients suffering from diseases of cardiac muscle dysfunction.

Reporting to the Associate Director for QA at Cytokinetics the QA Specialist for Drug Substance will perform review of batch documentation as part of the QA certification process. The role involves oversight and review of documentation relating to manufacturing, testing, release, and lifecycle management activities performed by Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), Contract Testing Laboratories (CTLs), and other GxP service providers.

  

The candidate will be part of a team that provides QA support and advice to internal and external customers and will execute day-to-day quality issues as they arise at Cytokinetics. They will be part of teams who work with Contract Manufactures for Drug product (DP). The role will provide support to the Qualified Person (QP) function to oversee our QA activities as we continue to supply our products.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Provide GMP Quality Assurance oversight for clinical and commercial manufacturing, and distribution activities performed at Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs).
* Perform Quality review of clinical and commercial batch records and supporting documentation to ensure compliance with cGMP requirements, approved manufacturing instructions and regulatory filings.
* Review manufacturing, and testing documentation to support batch disposition and product release.
* Review and approve deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls and associated Quality Management System records to ensure timely resolution and appropriate root cause analysis.
* Assess quality events for potential product impact and support risk-based quality decisions.
* Provide Quality support for technology transfers, process validation, engineering batches, process performance qualification (PPQ) and commercial launch activities.
* Review and approve GMP documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Master Batch Records, specifications, protocols, reports and work instructions.
* Participate as the Quality representative on cross-functional teams supporting clinical and commercial programs.
* Support implementation of manufacturing, packaging and process improvements through the change management process.
* Ensure compliance with Cytokinetics Quality Management System requirements, cGMP regulations and applicable global regulatory expectations.
* Support qualification and ongoing Quality oversight of CMOs, contract laboratories and other GMP service providers.
* Participate in internal audits, supplier audits and regulatory inspections, including inspection readiness activities and support for responses to audit observations.
* Support Product Quality Reviews (PQRs), Annual Product Reviews (APRs), Quality Management Reviews and Quality Metrics reporting.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, Supply Chain and Manufacturing partners to support CMC submissions, post-approval changes and regulatory commitments.
* Maintain GMP documentation and Quality records within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS).
* Identify opportunities to improve Quality Systems and GMP processes and participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide guidance to internal stakeholders and external partners on GMP quality requirements.
Perform other Quality Assurance duties as assigned to support business objectives.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering or technical discipline.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience within the biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical industry, with at least 3 years in GMP Quality Assurance.
* Experience supporting clinical and/or commercial pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Experience with oral solid dose pharmaceutical manufacturing and packaging.
* Working knowledge of US FDA, EU EMA and ICH cGMP regulations and industry guidance.
* Experience reviewing GMP batch documentation and supporting batch disposition activities.
* Experience managing or reviewing deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls and other Quality System records.
* Experience supporting Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and external manufacturing operations.
* Experience participating in GMP audits and regulatory inspections.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple functions and external partners.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
* Experience authoring and reviewing SOPs and controlled GMP documentation.
Experience using electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS), preferably Veeva Quality, TrackWise or similar platforms.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting commercial product launches.
* Experience supporting technology transfer and process validation activities.
* Knowledge of ICH Q7, Q8, Q9 and Q10 guidance.
* Experience working within a global external manufacturing network.
Continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma experience is desirable.

* Schedule appointments and manage patient inquiries both in person and over the phone.
* Collect and verify patient information, insurance details, and necessary documentation accurately.
* Help create a positive work environment and clinic culture by ensuring the patient’s needs are taken care of during transitional periods of therapy. Help provide customer service, a smile.

*Administrative Support:*

* Maintain patient records and ensure all documentation is complete and accurate.
* Assist in keeping front office area neat, tidy and organized.
* Coordinate with clinical staff to ensure seamless patient experience.
* Assist front office with front office tasks when down time occurs including but not limited to: answering the phone, scanning documents into charts, scheduling patients, taking over the counter payments, filing, faxing, etc.

*Communication and Coordination:*

* Liaise effectively between patients, clinical staff, and other departments within the facility.
* Communicate clearly and professionally to address patient concerns or questions.

* Maintain a clean and organized reception area.
* Assist in managing inventory and ordering office supplies as needed.
* Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas for process improvement.
* Ensure cleanliness and organization of therapy areas and equipment. Daily equipment cleaning, cleaning tables, laundry, stocking supplies.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; additional education in healthcare administration is a plus.
* Proven experience in a customer service role; healthcare setting preferred.
* Proficiency in using office software and scheduling systems.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to maintain professionalism in a fast-paced environment.
* Attention to detail and accuracy in handling patient information and documentation.

**Benefits & Perks**

We offer a comprehensive and competitive compensation package designed to support both personal and professional well being. Team members enjoy full scale benefits—including robust Medical, Vision, and Dental plans—along with paid time off, clinical incentive opportunities, and student loan repayment options. We are committed to your continued growth and success, providing professional development resources and ongoing clinical education support.

At PRN, you’ll be part of a supportive, mission driven environment dedicated to excellence in patient care and the success of every member of our team.

new_jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* Experience in supply chain risk assessment and supply chain resiliency.
Experience defining system logic, data hierarchies, and automation requirements to transform manual workflows into scalable, repeatable weekly processes.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience in supply chain planning, material management, or commodity management within the technology or AI hardware industry.
* Experience designing and implementing end-to-end planning architectures within ERP or advanced planning systems (e.g., SAP or proprietary tools).
* Experience defining system logic, data hierarchies, and automation requirements to transform manual workflows into scalable, repeatable planning engines.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing comprehensive manufacturing and execution strategies by integrating inputs across demand, capacity, material availability, financial budgets, and data center requirements. You will engage with key suppliers and commodity managers to ensure the timely availability of critical components.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $159000 - $230000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop short and long term supply and demand model that seek to maximize supply output while also balancing inventories and critically constrained parts.
* Establish and utilize best methods (statistical models, processes and software tools) in evaluating supply chain’s ability to meet customer demand.
* Lead demand and supply planning meetings with cross-functional teams, reviewing supply, demand risks/mitigation options/service level goals. Collaborate cross-functionally and drive resolution of supply chain exceptions/escalations in a timely manner.
* Prepare, report, and present supply and demand recommendations with sound models and logic to leadership, drive timely decisions, and ensure clear and concise communication to all stakeholders in the supply chain.
* Drive product success by keeping ourselves and others accountable for metrics such as forecast accuracy, on- time delivery, inventory, excess and obsolescence (E&O) and material spend.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.
