new_jobs.description:
**Department:**

Kinship

  

**Location:**

Hayward, CA

***Lincoln Families is a workplace that is committed to strengths-based, culturally responsive, attachment-centered, and trauma-informed care.***

  

**JOB TITLE:** Program Manager

**PROGRAM:** Kinship

**SALARY:** $90,000 annually

**KINSHIP SUPPORT SERVICES:** Children do best when they remain in safe, stable, and familiar environments that relatives can provide. Relative caregivers are the backbone of the child welfare system, stepping up to fill the gaps when challenges take parents away from raising their children. Many are grandparents with special needs liked to age, poverty, poor health, and lack of support and resources.

  

**WHAT WE DO:** Lincoln Families’ Kinship program provides supports to kin caregivers so they have the resources needed to raise their relative. Since 2001, our staff have addressed the unique needs of each caregiver and child, providing a variety of supports:

* **Family Coaching** - Providing advocacy and referral for financial assistance, legal supports, mental health, emergency, and education services
* **Education and Skill Building** - Offering programs including parenting and school advocacy to prepare and inform caregivers and youth
* **Youth Engagement** - Providing children and teen activity groups, social and recreational outings, tutoring, and workshop events
* **Support Groups** - Facilitating gatherings of caregivers to share joys and concerns, learn about resources, and support each other

**OUR WHY:** Children in foster care can face exposure to alcohol and other drugs, abuse, neglect and abandonment, violence in their homes and communities, trauma from separation from birth families, and frequent changes in foster care placement. These experiences place children at greater risk of developing physical, emotional, and behavioral problems that can lead to school failure, teen pregnancy, homelessness, unemployment, and incarceration. Research shows that living with relatives is better for children and benefits them in many ways. Of children who are not living with their biological parents, 75% of them are being raised by a relative outside of the formal foster care system. Such kin caregivers have little or no time to prepare for this new arrangement and face major barriers in accessing information, benefits, legal assistance, and services.

**POSITION SUMMARY:** Reporting to the Community-Based Services Program Director, this Program Manager provides leadership, budget oversight and accountability for the Kinship Support Services program. The duties include acting as a liaison to Alameda County Department of Children and Family Services, school district(s) in our service area, funding sources, and referring/resource partners.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Ensures quality and accountability in all program functions and services.
* Hires, assesses, supervises, and coaches staff as needed to manage the personnel and service functions of assigned programs.
* Develops and monitors program budgets; provides reports to appropriate agencies in a timely manner.
* Responsible for facilitating communication between program staff and other agency personnel.
* Liaisons with public and private agencies.
* Represents Agency in the area of public relations.
* Develops new programs, expands existing programs according to client, community interest, and needs.
* Anticipates personnel needs. Plans for future and recommends cost effective measures for site development and maintenance.
* Identifies new funding streams for program development and enhancement.
* Ensures all staff maintain HIPAA and COA compliance.
* Participates when needed in board and program committee meetings and other appropriate committee meetings (Budget, Personnel, Facilities, etc.)

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS:**

A positive, relationally adept, service-oriented leader who thrives in a fast-paced, busy environment and is organized to handle often competing deadlines. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to problem-solve as well as coach and develop staff. Must be deadline-driven, detail-oriented and able to maintain high levels of confidentiality and professionalism. Demonstrated awareness of, sensitivity to and competence in dealing with cultural and socioeconomic diversity of client population; knowledge of trauma informed and culturally responsive interventions with youth and families. Committed to helping the organization with equity, diversity and inclusion work both through leading initiatives and engaging in reflective work. Can work independently but also asks for help when necessary.

**EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred (equivalent work experience may be considered)
* Master’s degree in Social Work or human services related field a plus
* 3 years of relevant work experience in human services required
* 1 year of supervisory experience required
* Experience managing program or project budgets preferred
* Experience managing reports to funders and meeting compliance expectations a plus
* Lived experience with kinship caregiving or work experience with kinship families is highly desirable
* Strong computer skills with intermediate proficiency in Microsoft programs and/or Google Suite
* Fluency in Spanish (verbal and written) preferred.

**WHY JOIN LINCOLN FAMILIES:**

* **Salary:** $90,000 annually
* **Time Off**: 4 weeks of vacation, 13 sick days, 5 additional CA paid sick leave days and 11 holidays (including 2 flex holidays); vacation and sick time begin accruing from day one of employment.
* **Benefits**: Medical HRA (Health Reimbursement Arrangement) plan with employer-paid premiums (100% employees and 50% dependents) and employer-paid deductibles with Kaiser; alternate plans also available at employee's cost for Sutter or Health Savings Account. new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Insidesource DEI Statement**

By nurturing a culture where everyone experiences a deep sense of belonging and equity of opportunity, we will uphold our vision to “unleash human and business potential.” We commit to being an anti-ism workplace and embedding diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout our business.

**Job Summary**

The Account Manager manages accounts and project teams in support of all project and daily work activities, from scope development through task or project completion. With a highly consultative approach, they deliver tailored solutions and full client satisfaction throughout the entire project lifecycle, and build strong, sustainable customer relationships. They are responsible for meeting agreed upon revenue and margin goals.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Client/Account Servicing**

* Develop and nurture client relationships in support of building trust, aligning business requirements, and increasing revenue opportunities and profitability.
* Maintain comprehensive understanding of client needs, goals, business practices and satisfaction/performance criteria.
* Act as single point of contact for coordination and execution of Insidesource activities (ie. Pre- and post-sale).
* Responsible for overall performance of Insidesource account / project teams (sales support, design, project management and field service teams).
* Accountable for end-to-end client experience and satisfaction.
* Provide timely response to customer requests for products, services, and information.
* Ensure generation of weekly status reports.
* Responsible for relevant third-party influencers - contractors, A&D and PM firms, etc. - in relation to client account/projects.

**Sales, Project, and Work Order Management**

* Enter and maintain sales forecast in CRM.
* Partner with New Business Development/Account Executives to respond to requests for information, pricing and/or services; lead RFP response as needed.
* With support from Insidesource teams, produce plans, develop specifications, generate detailed and accurate quotes, and present to customer in timely manner.
* Develop and execute service contracts and service level agreements.
* Deliver responsible close of sale requirements by obtaining signed proposals, terms and conditions, customer purchase orders, and deposits.
* Ensure obstacles and/or changes in scope are identified, documented, and resolved, and ensure client and Insidesource satisfaction throughout project lifecycle.
* Oversee and direct Insidesource implementation of all client projects, work orders, and service requests.
* Review and/or establish work plans, schedules, and logistics.
* Oversee work of all team members, including designers, project managers, account coordinators, delivery, and installation crews.
* Perform project management responsibilities as required, including site visits during installations.
* Provide (and prepare, if required) project and work order status reports.
* Attend project and construction meetings as required.
* Provide exceptional leadership and communication to customer and internal teams.
* Achievement of annual sales goals as established by Manager.

**Leadership and Professional Development**

* Manage positive and productive interactions of internal and external teams, including collaboration with subcontractors and manufacturers.
* Manage workload of internal teams to ensure activities are appropriately balanced and supported.
* Provide mentorship and encourage growth and development of team members.

* Participation in weekly Sales Meetings and Monthly Staff Meetings.
* Regular attendance at industry events.

**Insidesource Core Responsibilities**

* Exemplify Insidesource values of Team First, Client Led, Change Makers, Experience Focused.
* Participate in All Company Meetings and Regional Town Halls.
* Embody diversity, equity, and inclusion in our Insider community and business practices.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None

**Skills, Knowledge, Experience Required**

* Account Management experience in the contract furniture industry required.
* Experience working on RFPs.
* Product knowledge and product specification experience.
* Ability to lead and inspire cross functional players.
* Eye for design and layout of marketing materials.
* Solid skills in copy-editing, grammar, spelling, and punctuation.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Teams, Word, Outlook, Power Point).

* Proficiency in Adobe Systems (Photoshop, InDesign) CORE, Hubspot, Miro, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Understanding of the complexities and sophistication required to thrive in the dealer environment.
* Fluid interpersonal skills to interact effectively with a wide range of customers, vendors, personnel, and departments.
* Ability to see the big picture and integrate into day-to-day tasks and activities.
* Excellent and effective oral and written communication.
* Prior experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced work environment.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong organizational and administrative skills
* Experience in customer service required.
* Demonstrated commitment to professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment in business transactions, and to providing the highest level of customer satisfaction.

*The anticipated salary range for this role is $80K-110K. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity.*

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Vibrant Wellness is a science-driven biotechnology and health diagnostics company focused on improving health outcomes through advanced testing, reliable data, and collaboration across scientific and business teams.

**Our Vision**

We aim to advance healthcare through data, science, and innovation, helping providers and patients make more informed decisions.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on **Revenue Operations & Marketing Analytics Manager** to improve the systems, processes, and reporting that support our go-to-market strategy.

This role owns HubSpot administration, funnel analytics, marketing attribution, data modeling, and executive reporting. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to improve data quality, understand performance, and turn insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage and improve HubSpot workflows, automation, lifecycle stages, lead management, and CRM data structure.
* Build and refine lead-routing rules, sales pipelines, and deal-stage definitions.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience developing and implementing strategies that leverage AI and AI-powered tools (e.g., Agentic AI) in a support context.
* Expertise in translating data and user feedback into actionable product improvements and strategic recommendations.
* Experience in the Smart Home technology.
* Proven track record of launching and supporting consumer hardware, software, or subscription products.
* Ability to grow in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment while leading complex, cross-functional projects.

**About the job**
-----------------

In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration, and more).

As a Product Support Manager within the gUP Home Product Excellence, you will be a critical partner and trusted advisor to the Home Product team, translating complex user feedback and support data into actionable insights that shape the future of our Home portfolio.

In this role, you will require a deep understanding of the user journey, a passion for product quality, and the ability to engage strategically in a dynamic, cross-functional environment. You will drive product excellence strategy and execution for a discrete feature area, from ensuring flawless launches to driving long-term improvements that fulfill our mission to create a home that takes care of the people inside it and the world around it.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***  
The Manager of Clinical Product Operations supports by driving clinical initiative deployment, workflow optimization, and change adoption across Devoted Medical clinical teams.

Analyzes clinical operational needs and collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to define, refine, and implement clinical workflows.

Reports directly to the Sr. Manager, Clinical Initiatives, partnering with leadership and training teams to execute new workflow rollouts seamlessly.

Leverages Electronic Health Record (EHR) and clinical documentation expertise to enhance systems functionality and clinical practice alignment.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* **Clinical Workflow Strategy:** Partnership with Engineering/Data/AI/Operations team to support Enterprise goals. Partner with Clinical Informatics to map, document, and optimize current and future clinical workflows.
* **Initiative Planning:** Collaborate with product and operational leadership to define priorities, participating with R&D planning, Central Initiatives planning and workflow intake processes to develop monthly sprint plans.
* **Rollout Execution:** Plan and manage the end-to-end deployment of new clinical initiatives, overseeing the transition from pilot/Test Kitchen phases to enterprise-wide launch.
* **Change Management:** Develop and distribute communication plans, rollout materials, and training resources to ensure seamless adoption.
* **Training & Support:** Facilitate training sessions for end-users, educate designated SMEs and managers on launch initiatives, and provide post-deployment troubleshooting.
* **System Alignment:** Leverage EHR expertise to enhance system functionality and ensure clinical practice alignment.
* **Performance Analysis:** Evaluate usability, adoption, and operational impact; bridge frontline feedback to R&D teams to drive iterative improvements.

* **Adoption:** Achievement of initiative adoption thresholds as defined by the Senior Leadership.
* **Usability:** Maintenance of Orinoco (EHR) usability score targets to influence R&D investments.
* **Delivery:** Adherence to enterprise change calendar; optimizing for transparency and timeliness of launch.
* **Impact:** Documented scale, iteration, or sunset decision for all launched initiatives.
* **Documentation:** Maintain current and discoverable standards for cross-functional enterprise-wide workflows.

***Required skills and experience:***

* Bachelor’s degree with five years of healthcare or product management experience
* 2+ years experience with enterprise change management scaling
* Prior advanced or superuser EMR experience.
* 2+ years experience in clinical project/process management or informatics experience

***Desired skills and experience:***

* **Clinical Expertise:** Practicing Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) or Registered Nurse (RN) with 5+ years of clinical experience.
* **Licensure:** An active license to practice in at least one Devoted Medical market is preferred.
* **Education:** Master’s degree preferred, with two years of telehealth experience.
* **Soft Skills:** Exemplary interpersonal and communication skills, with a solution-oriented, critical analysis mindset.
* **Self-Management:** Highly motivated, capable of working independently or in teams, with strong organizational skills to prioritize multiple projects and meet deadlines.

***Salary Range:*** 73,000 - $130,000 per year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Fabletics** is looking for a **Business Analyst, Product Creation Technology.**

  

**How do you fit in?**

  

FableticsOS is seeking a highly motivated Business Analyst to support Product Creation Technology initiatives across our growing suite of systems—including PLM (Centric), ERP (BlueCherry), supply chain platforms, planning and allocation tools, and B2B systems (NuOrder). This role bridges business needs and technical solutions, owning documentation, analysis, testing, and execution of enhancements as PC Tech's scope continues to expand across B2B, supply chain, and product development. The ideal candidate is an analytical problem-solver with strong documentation expertise, a deep understanding of system workflows, and a proven ability to collaborate across diverse business and technical teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Product Management, PC Technology.

  

As a Business Analyst on the PC Tech team, you sit at the intersection of business and technology—translating complex operational needs into clear, actionable requirements across multiple domains. You free up PM capacity for strategic work by owning documentation, UAT, and support with depth and rigor. You're comfortable working across product creation, supply chain, planning and allocation, and B2B, building strong relationships with stakeholders at every level, and your work directly enables the systems that power Fabletics' global operations.

  

**What you will do:**

**Requirements & Documentation**

* Create and maintain documentation including PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scripts

* Serve as a liaison between business users and technical teams to capture, clarify, and validate requirements across PC, supply chain, planning/allocation, and B2B workstreams

Partner with product managers and engineers to translate complex business processes into clear, structured requirements that engineering and vendor teams can execute against  

  

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Lead and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT), developing and executing test scripts, coordinating test participants across business teams, and tracking defect resolution

Partner with QA and engineering on regression testing for system enhancements and releases  

  

**Systems Coverage**

* Support initiatives across PLM (Centric), ERP (BlueCherry), supply chain platforms (Four Kites, Pivot-88, sustainability tools), planning and allocation systems (Blue Yonder), and B2B tools (NuOrder), developing deep functional knowledge of how each connects across end-to-end workflows

Identify integration gaps and data flow issues across systems, surfacing them with clear documentation and recommendations  

  

**Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for PC technology systems, troubleshooting complex system and data issues and recommending scalable solutions

Triage incoming support requests, prioritize based on business impact, and coordinate resolution with technical teams  

  

**Agile Delivery**

* Apply Scrum practices—facilitating stand-ups, backlog grooming, and sprint planning—while maintaining well-groomed backlogs with clearly scoped stories and acceptance criteria

Track sprint progress, flag blockers, and communicate status to stakeholders  

  

**Change Management & Training**

* Support change management and training efforts to drive adoption across business teams following system enhancements and launches

Develop training materials, process guides, and release notes, acting as a go-to resource for teams navigating new features or process changes  

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate cross-functionally with product creation, supply chain, planning, wholesale, finance, and tech teams, building trusted relationships that enable proactive identification of system needs

Participate in vendor calls and workstream reviews to represent business requirements and ensure delivery alignment  

  

**What you can bring:**

**Experience**

* 4–6+ years of experience in a Business Analysis, Systems Administrator, or product support role

* Proven experience authoring business and technical documentation (PRDs, specs, user stories, acceptance criteria)

Strong track record in UAT planning, script development, and execution across multiple systems and business functions in a fast-paced environment  

  

**Execution**

* Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex, multi-system landscapes

* Proven ability to multi-task and balance competing project priorities with strong attention to detail and follow-through

Working knowledge of agile methodologies (Scrum) and solid understanding of change management and user training practices  

  

**Technical**

* Proficiency with project and collaboration tools including Jira, Confluence, and Asana

Familiarity with system integrations and data flows across enterprise platforms, with comfort reading technical documentation, data models, and API/integration specs  

  

**Communication**

* Strong stakeholder communication and facilitation skills across business and technical audiences, with the ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams

Enthusiastic thought-partner eager to apply strategic thinking and analytical skills in a fast-paced, high-growth, entrepreneurial environment

new_jobs.description:
IT Project Manager (Healthcare IT)
==================================

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **FLSA Status:** Exempt
* **Department:** Operations – Project Management Office (PMO)
* **Work Location:** Remote - U.S.

Position Summary 
**The Project Manager leads client-facing IT infrastructure and managed services projects from initiation through closure. This role translates technical scope into practical project plans, coordinates technical teams, vendors, procurement, and client stakeholders, and keeps projects aligned with scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. By delivering organized, proactive project leadership, this position strengthens the client experience, supports timely delivery and revenue, and expands the Project Management Office’s capacity.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of client-facing IT projects, including managed services onboardings, migrations, offboardings, infrastructure implementations, cybersecurity deployments, hardware refreshes, and environment upgrades.
* Review statements of work, technical requirements, budgets, dependencies, and resource needs to confirm delivery readiness before kickoff.
* Develop clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, acceptance criteria, go-live checkpoints, and transition-to-support activities.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects while monitoring scope, schedules, budgets, labor hours, documentation, client commitments, and hardware or vendor dependencies.
* Lead client-facing and internal project meetings, communicate status and decisions, and ensure required actions are completed.
* Coordinate engineers, technical leads, Procurement, Account Management, Sales, vendors, and client stakeholders across interdependent workstreams.
* Identify risks, scope changes, blockers, and conflicting requirements early; recommend solutions and escalate decisions when needed.
* Validate implementation readiness, quality assurance, client acceptance, billing milestones, and closure criteria.
* Maintain accurate project records and status updates in project management systems and contribute to process improvements and lessons learned.
* Build trusted relationships while setting clear expectations, holding owners accountable, and maintaining a confident, solutions-oriented approach.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Project Management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* At least four years of experience managing client-facing IT infrastructure or managed services projects in an MSP, technology services provider, consulting organization, or similarly complex customer-facing environment.
* Experience leading projects involving several of the following: networking, servers, endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud platforms, identity and access, cybersecurity, migrations, hardware deployment, site readiness, or IT environment assessments.
* Ability to interpret statements of work, technical requirements, and solution documentation and turn them into actionable delivery plans.
* Strong knowledge of project controls, including scope, schedule, budget, resource planning, risk and issue management, acceptance criteria, and go-live readiness.
* Experience coordinating technical resources, vendors, procurement, account teams, and clients across resource-constrained, interdependent workstreams.
* Proven ability to identify technical and operational risks, resolve ambiguity, manage scope changes, and escalate issues with clear recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to facilitate technical discussions, hold owners accountable, and present concise updates to clients and leadership.
* Proficiency with project management platforms and Microsoft 365 applications, including Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience supporting healthcare, senior care, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with ConnectWise, Jira, GuideCX, or a comparable project management platform.
* PMP, CAPM, CompTIA Project+, Network+, Security+, ITIL, or another relevant project management or technical certification.
* Experience managing a high-volume project portfolio in a resource-constrained environment.

What Success Looks Like 
**A high-performing Project Manager keeps a complex portfolio moving with clear plans, accurate documentation, proactive risk management, and consistent follow-through. Success is demonstrated through confident client communication, strong accountability across technical and cross-functional teams, timely and effective project delivery, and a positive impact on client satisfaction, team capacity, and business performance.**

new_jobs.description:
Join Brightree Patient Collections, part of ResMed, as a Senior Customer Success Specialist and become a trusted advisor to a portfolio of healthcare customers. In this role, you'll build strong client relationships, deliver strategic guidance, and help customers maximize the value of their billing and collections programs. You'll partner with clients to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and improve revenue cycle performance while serving as their primary point of contact. If you enjoy combining customer partnership, financial insight, and problem-solving to drive measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact for both customers and the patients they serve.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, building trusted relationships that support long-term satisfaction, retention, and success.

* Coordinate and facilitate customer training, helping clients effectively utilize solutions and achieve business objectives.

* Maintain regular customer touchpoints to ensure proactive communication, alignment on priorities, and visibility into emerging needs.

* Analyze customer data, trends, and operational challenges to identify issues, uncover opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.

* Partner with clients to identify revenue management challenges and improve financial performance through informed, data-driven recommendations.

* Recommend and implement corrective actions that help resolve outstanding financial issues and support stronger collection outcomes.

* Collaborate with internal partners and fellow account managers to enhance programs, improve customer experiences, and drive greater value from solutions.

Monitor account health and performance, helping customers achieve their goals while strengthening business results.  

  

**What You Bring**

* Associate's degree required; bachelor's degree preferred.

* 1–3 years of account management, business-to-business sales, customer success, or related experience.

* Experience in the HME/DME industry and medical billing.

* Experience working with home health billing software.

* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to evaluate information, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.

* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering effective solutions.

* Business and financial acumen with the ability to align customer goals to business outcomes.

* Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills.

* Ability to communicate and influence effectively across a variety of stakeholder levels, including executive audiences.

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* Bachelor's degree.

Financial analysis experience.  

  

**What Sets You Apart**

* Customer Advocate — You build trust quickly and consistently seek solutions that create value for customers.

* Analytical Curiosity — You look beyond surface-level issues to uncover root causes and meaningful opportunities for improvement.

* Ownership Mindset — You take initiative, follow through on commitments, and stay accountable for results.

* Relationship Builder — You foster productive partnerships that encourage collaboration and long-term success.

* Adaptability — You remain effective when priorities shift and can balance multiple demands without losing focus.

Integrity First — You approach every interaction with professionalism, transparency, and sound judgment.  

  

**Why Join ResMed**

At ResMed, we're driven by a mission to help people live healthier, higher-quality lives. Through Brightree Patient Collections, you'll help healthcare providers improve financial performance so they can focus on delivering care to the patients who rely on them.

We invest in our people through comprehensive benefits, flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, and a culture that supports growth and wellbeing. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, HSA and FSA programs, commuter benefits, a 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Employee Assistance Program, tuition assistance, generous paid time off, paid holidays, caregiver leave, and more.

We are shaping the future at ResMed, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world’s best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. Employees scheduled to work 30 or more hours per week are eligible for benefits. new_jobs.title: Traveling Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What You’ll Do:**

As a Traveling Operations Manager, you’ll participate in the property’s operations to ensure that exceptional service is delivered to all residents and that the property continues to meet its financial goals. You’ll also serve as a leader in our organization, being a champion of the Coastal Ridge culture and ensuring associates have the tools, resources, and direction to be engaged and successful.

**Where You’ll Work:**

As a Traveling Operations Manager, you will work at one of our properties nationwide on a temporary basis to provide support and management based on property and market demand or in the absence of other team members. This role will be based in Columbus, OH with 100% travel with potential assignments outside of Columbus, OH. You can expect to work at any one property for one week or multiple weeks based on need.

**What You'll Own:**

* Ensure community meets all monthly, quarterly and annual financial and operational targets, including achieving the highest possible net operating income through effective cost control and revenue
* Oversee and participate in all aspects of leasing production, including leasing administration, marketing activities and maintaining product knowledge of community and competitors to maximize rental income and budgeted occupancy.
* Oversee and participate in all aspects of rent collections, file necessary evictions and ensure landlord/resident laws are followed.
* Provide excellent customer service including managing resident retention, monitoring timeliness and quality of service requests, and ensuring aesthetic standards are maintained to the highest level for all aspects of each community.
* Oversee, assist, and hold accountable all office and maintenance team members to ensure proper execution of individual responsibilities, while promoting a positive, goal-oriented work environment.
* Train and mentor individual team members to ensure the understanding of approved policies, procedures and protocols to perform daily responsibilities.
* Perform team management duties including hiring, onboarding, terminations, and corrective actions.
* Ensure completion, accuracy, and timelines of all regular and ad-hoc reporting requirements.
* Act as the primary point of contact between the corporate office and property, interacting with investors as necessary.
* Other tasks as directed and assigned.

**What You'll Bring:**

* High school degree or equivalent required, bachelor’s degree in Property Management, Business or related field preferred.
* 3 – 5 years of progressive experience in a multifamily property management role. At least one-year prior Property Manager experience preferred.
* Experience with Entrata or similar software systems preferred.
* Intermediate experience with Microsoft Excel, including experience creating formulas, sorting, filtering, etc.
* Previous experience in multifamily student housing and luxury multifamily conventional housing strongly preferred.

**Who You Are:**

* *A people leader.* Let’s be real – managing people is hard. Ideally, you’ve coached, directly managed, and demonstrably moved the effectiveness of other adults before taking this job. You build relationships across lines of difference, inspire and motivate others to buy into your vision, navigate challenging conversations with finesse, make tough calls, invest in the development of your team, communicate
* *Customer service driven.* You approach residents, prospects, and vendors with a positive, friendly attitude and take pride in providing top-notch service by building long-term relationships and going above and beyond customer expectations. You take responsibility for and quickly rectify mistakes and respond to complaints in a timely and empathetic manner.
* *A courageous problem* solver. You keep it cool when things get crazy, approach problems with viable solutions, and know when you need to roll up your sleeves to support the team.
* *A masterful executor.* You get things done. You fervently plan backwards to meet timelines, achieve big goals, and manage complex projects in a fast-paced environment with many moving pieces and stakeholders and ensure goals reach or surpass the finish line.

Built on the foundation of over 20 years of friendships, Coastal Ridge is a vertically integrated multifamily real estate operator, investor, and developer whose unique approach successfully combines data and experience. As a Coastal Ridge Real Estate associate, you’ll be eligible to participate in a variety of benefit programs designed to fit you and your lifestyle. We are committed to providing competitive and comprehensive benefits that align with our culture and the needs of our associates.

* Bilingual or multilingual abilities are highly desirable for engaging diverse customer bases

new_jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager - Detroit, MI
new_jobs.description:
#### **Position Summary**

The Senior Operations Manager is responsible for providing operational leadership and oversight across Nationwide Auto Services project operations. This position leads and supports NAS Operations Managers and Field Teams responsible for Overspray, Workforce Solutions, Automotive Services, and Agriculture Equipment / High and Heavy projects.

The Senior Operations Project Manager serves as the primary operational link between NAS leadership, Project Managers, field teams, and customers. The role is accountable for ensuring projects are properly planned, staffed, launched, executed, measured, and closed while meeting customer requirements, safety standards, quality expectations, financial targets, and contractual obligations.

This position requires a hands-on leader who can manage multiple projects, Operations Managers, and Field Teams across different locations and service lines while maintaining consistent NAS operating standards.

Key Responsibilities

#### **Project Management Leadership**

* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to NAS Operations Managers across assigned projects and service lines.
* Establish clear expectations, priorities, responsibilities, and performance standards for Operations Managers.
* Conduct regular project reviews covering staffing, productivity, safety, quality, schedule, customer requirements, financial performance, and open risks.
* Support Operations Managers and Field Supervisors with issue resolution, resource planning, customer escalations, and operational decisionmaking.
* Ensure Operations Managers maintain accurate project documentation, reporting, timekeeping, staffing records, training records, and customer deliverables.
* Develop consistent project management practices and operating standards across NAS locations.

#### **Operational Oversight**

* Overspray Services: Vehicle inspections, contamination assessment, overspray removal, quality verification, production tracking, and customer reporting.
* Workforce Solutions: Staffing programs supporting customer operations, including workforce planning, recruiting coordination, onboarding, scheduling, productivity management, attendance, and performance.
* Automotive Services: Vehicle inspection, repair campaigns, rework, accessory installation, paint and body repair, hail damage repair, yard services, quality campaigns, and other OEM or logisticsrelated services.
* Agriculture Equipment / High and Heavy Services: Inspection, repair, modification, campaign, processing, yard, and related services supporting agricultural, construction, and other high and heavy equipment.

#### **Project Launch and Execution**

* Lead operational planning for new projects from award through implementation.
* Review scopes of work, customer requirements, pricing assumptions, labor models, equipment requirements, schedules, and project milestones before launch.
* Develop project launch plans identifying staffing, leadership, equipment, training, safety requirements, reporting, and customer communication.
* Coordinate with Business Development, Human Resources, Recruiting, Safety, Finance, Quality, and other NAS functions to ensure projects are properly supported.
* Conduct project readiness reviews before startup and stabilization reviews following launch.
* Identify potential operational risks early and develop corrective or contingency plans.

#### **Financial and Performance Management**

* Monitor project performance against approved labor models, budgets, productivity targets, and customer requirements.
* Review labor hours, overtime, staffing levels, utilization, productivity, and other cost drivers.
* Partner with Finance and leadership to identify projects performing outside expected financial targets.
* Work with Operations Managers to develop corrective action plans when operational or financial performance falls below expectations.
* Validate that completed work and supporting documentation are captured accurately and submitted timely for invoicing.

#### **Customer Management**

* Establish strong working relationships with customer operational leadership and key stakeholders.
* Participate in customer business reviews, project meetings, startup meetings, and operational performance discussions.
* Ensure customer concerns and escalations are addressed promptly and communicated to NAS leadership when appropriate.
* Identify additional customer needs or service opportunities and communicate them to Business Development and executive leadership.
* Maintain professional representation of NAS at customer facilities and industry locations.

#### **Safety, Quality and Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture across all assigned projects.
* Ensure field teams comply with NAS safety requirements and customer sitespecific requirements.
* Confirm employees have completed required technical, safety, HR, and customer training before performing assigned work.
* Monitor quality performance and ensure corrective actions are implemented when standards are not met.
* Support incident investigations, corrective actions, root cause reviews, and preventive measures.
* Ensure operations comply with applicable customer contracts, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

#### **Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Establish consistent reporting standards across assigned projects.
* Provide NAS leadership with regular project status updates covering safety, quality, staffing, productivity, financial performance, customer concerns, risks, and upcoming priorities.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators for Operations Managers, field supervisors, field employees and project operations.
* Identify operational best practices that can be implemented across multiple NAS projects.
* Lead post project reviews and capture lessons learned for future projects.
* Support development of Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, project launch templates,

**Operations ManagerLead the People, Processes, Systems, and Performance Behind a Growing Immigration Law Firm**

MRA Law Group is seeking an experienced, hands-on **Operations Manager** to lead the day-to-day performance, accountability, systems coordination, and continuous improvement of our Operations Department.

This is a leadership role for someone who knows how to turn expectations into execution.

The Operations Manager will oversee the operational teams responsible for supporting our clients, attorneys, and case production functions, from the first phone call through ongoing client communication, administrative support, document handling, internal operational requests, and systems-related execution.

We are looking for someone who can manage people, build accountability, analyze performance, improve processes, coordinate systems support, solve problems, and create an Operations Department that runs consistently without requiring constant intervention from senior leadership.

**What You Will Own**

**Operations Leadership & Team Management**

You will provide leadership and accountability across the Operations Department, including:

* Operations Team Lead
* Telephone Receptionist Team Lead and Receptionists
* Client CARE Team Lead and Client CARE Agents
* Virtual Assistant
* In-Office Administrative Assistant
* In-Office Legal Assistant
* Systems Administrator
* Systems Developer

You will establish clear expectations, ensure accountability, coach leaders and team members, identify performance issues early, and ensure the department has the structure, workflows, tools, and resources necessary to perform effectively.

You will be expected to manage both people and execution. This includes ensuring that team leaders are leading, frontline employees are meeting expectations, and systems-related support is helping the firm operate faster, cleaner, and more efficiently.

**Operational Performance & Accountability**

You will:

* Establish, monitor, and manage departmental and individual KPIs.
* Review daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly operational performance.
* Hold team leaders accountable for the performance of their respective teams.
* Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, capacity issues, recurring problems, and operational risks.
* Develop corrective action and coaching plans when performance falls below expectations.
* Ensure operational audits are completed and identified issues are addressed.
* Build an environment where ownership, follow-through, and accountability are part of everyday operations.

The current Operations framework measures department efficiency, workflow effectiveness, error reduction, client communication compliance, client satisfaction, complaints, procedure compliance, system usage, documentation accuracy, team KPI achievement, audits, issue-resolution time, process improvement, and operational risk identification.

**Systems, Technology & Operational Infrastructure**

The Operations Manager will play a key leadership role in ensuring the firm’s systems support the way the business actually needs to operate.

You will oversee the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer to ensure that systems, workflows, automations, reports, user access, troubleshooting, and technology improvements are properly prioritized and executed.

You will:

* Ensure operational systems are being used consistently and correctly.
* Translate operational needs into clear systems requirements.
* Coordinate with the Systems Administrator and Systems Developer on workflow improvements, automation opportunities, reporting needs, and system-related issues.
* Ensure system changes are aligned with operational goals and do not create unnecessary disruption.
* Monitor system usage, documentation accuracy, and compliance with required workflows.
* Identify gaps between process design, system capability, and actual team execution.
* Help prioritize technology improvements based on business impact, urgency, and scalability.
* Ensure systems-related projects are completed with clear ownership, timelines, testing, rollout, and follow-through.

This role does not require the Operations Manager to be a programmer. However, it does require someone who can understand operational problems, ask the right questions, manage systems-related priorities, and ensure technology supports performance instead of becoming another bottleneck.

**Client Experience**

Our Operations Department plays a major role in how clients experience MRA Law Group.

You will ensure:

* Client calls and communications are handled professionally and promptly.
* Reception and Client CARE teams consistently meet service expectations.
* Client concerns are identified, documented, and escalated appropriately.
* Communication breakdowns do not become preventable client complaints.
* Operational issues contributing to cancellations, dissatisfaction, or refund exposure are identified and addressed.
* Client feedback and satisfaction trends are monitored and converted into practical operational improvements.

**Processes & Continuous Improvement**

We do not want someone who simply maintains existing processes. We want someone who asks:

**Why are we doing it this way, is it working, and can we do it better?**

You will:

* Develop, document, implement, and continuously improve SOPs and workflows.
* Ensure consistent use of the firm’s case management system, trackers, and operational tools.
* Ensure tasks, communications, and activities are properly documented.
* Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, bottlenecks, process gaps, and ownership gaps.
* Translate operational problems into practical, measurable solutions.
* Implement improvements and measure whether they actually worked.
* Identify operational risks before they become larger client, legal, financial, or business problems.

Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options:

* **Central, Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time:** 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm
* **Eastern Time:** 9am to 6pm ET only

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
* Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
* Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
* Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
* Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

**Who You Are**

* A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.

* Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
* Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.

* At least 1 year of experience as a health coach is required.
* Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is required.
* Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
* Fluency in Spanish is required.
* Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.

Responsibilities:

**Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.**

* Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
* Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
* Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. *Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.*

**Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.**

* Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
* Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
* Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
* Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. *Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.*

**Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.**

* Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
* Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
* Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. *Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.*
* Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

**Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.**

* Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.
* Gather qualitative intel from direct observation of client environments and anecdotal evidence from routine interviews, e.g., pain points, nuances in their use cases, feedback on features, and opportunities for more training. *Note: We often go off script for our largest clients in helping them resolve emergencies, so it will be a challenge to promote long-term health while dealing with the short-term “crisis of the week.”*
* Gather quantitative intel from analysis of client click paths and usage metrics to identify patterns of (mis)use, interpreting these insights in light of their stories.
* Identify gaps and overlaps between clients’ existing processes and our intended use cases to advise their scope and sequence in adopting our solutions.

new_jobs.description:
**Shape the future of enterprise data orchestration, runtime governance, and AI-driven connectivity.**

Are you a natural relationship builder who loves uncovering customer business challenges and guiding them toward transformative solutions? We are looking for an **Account Manager – Customer Growth** to join our team. In this role, you won't just be reactively fielding incoming requests. You will be the trusted, strategic face of Tavio—working directly with our existing clients to identify new integration opportunities, expand our platform footprint, and guide their transition to the comprehensive Tavio iPaaS platform (including Studio and Hub).

**About Us: The Prerequisite for Agentic AI**

At Tavio, our mission is to eliminate data chaos. But we are not just another lightweight iPaaS. As Artificial Intelligence accelerates how integrations are built and autonomous agents begin executing complex workflows, the true enterprise bottleneck is shifting from connectivity to governance. AI cannot safely execute multi-system workflows without strict, underlying data governance and reliable pipelines.

Tavio provides the secure, structured data rails—the context tier—that Agentic AI requires to operate safely across an enterprise ecosystem. Built on AWS, our next-generation orchestration platform and expert managed services allow tech providers, consultants, and enterprise companies to seamlessly scale critical integrations with embedded policy enforcement. At Tavio, we don't just build connectors: we are building the trusted infrastructure for the future of automated data operations.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

You will be at the absolute forefront of our platform's commercial growth strategy. While our technology solves highly complex workflows for our clients, your job is to be their strategic advisor as they evolve their integration landscape. Backed by a collaborative Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product team, you will spend your days learning about our customers' technology environments, mapping out their business goals, and delivering high-value solutions. If you love consultative selling, account strategy, and being a critical driver of revenue in an innovative tech space, you'll fit right in.

**Your Day-to-Day Activities May Include:**

* **Account Growth & Expansion:** Developing account-specific growth plans, identifying platform expansion opportunities, and driving adoption of the broader Tavio iPaaS suite (Studio and Hub).
* **Proactive Customer Discovery:** Conducting regular business and discovery conversations to understand customer tech stacks (ATS, HRIS, ERP, WMS, TMS, etc.), identifying manual integration gaps, and forecasting their integration needs for the next 6–12 months.
* **Stakeholder Mapping:** Building and nurturing relationships beyond primary technical contacts, mapping out business, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* **iPaaS Conversion:** Strategically prioritizing and converting legacy and Managed Services customers into broader platform users.
* **Opportunity & Pipeline Management:** Qualifying expansion opportunities, coordinating with Sales Engineers for solution demos, building commercial proposals, negotiating agreements, and maintaining accurate forecasts in CRM.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partnering closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Product, and Sales leadership to ensure account alignment and maximum customer value.
* **Customer Retention & Renewals:** Monitoring account health, proactively addressing renewal risks, and securing long-term contract renewals to ensure sustained growth and high satisfaction across key accounts.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, account management, or customer expansion with a proven track record of growing existing account revenue and carrying a target/quota.
* **Consultative Selling:** Strong discovery skills with a natural ability to ask insightful questions and uncover unstated customer needs.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working understanding of SaaS technology, APIs, integrations, and data movement (experience in iPaaS, HR tech, supply chain, or integration platforms is a major plus).
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to comfortably engage both technical leads and executive decision-makers.
* **Sales Discipline:** Strong CRM management habits, strategic account planning capabilities, and the grit to thrive in a nimble, fast-growing company.

**Our Core Values:**

* **Stronger Together:** A culture of respect and mutual support.
* **Client Success First:** Delivering real value through adaptable technology.
* **Evolving Partnerships:** Built on transparency and trust.
* **Intentional Efficiency:** Making thoughtful decisions for maximum impact.

* Paid time off

new_jobs.title: Growth Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Introduction to Eficode**

We’re building the future of software development - driving innovation across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, Service Management, and AI-powered transformation. Our mission is to help organizations evolve into truly software-driven enterprises, empowering them to deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably. We believe in changing the world by sharing our expertise and enabling teams to work better through modern technology and intelligent automation.

With more than 600 experts across 10 countries, Eficode brings together people from across the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK and the Americas. We’re an Atlassian Platinum Partner, a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA and an Azure Managed Service Provider.

Now, we’re looking for a Growth Account Manager to join our growing US Sales team and help accelerate our growth across new and expanding enterprise accounts.

**Role purpose**

If you’re an ambitious technology sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships and turning customer challenges into commercial opportunities, this could be a great opportunity.

As a Growth Account Manager, you’ll drive pipeline growth across the US through targeted outreach to prospective and expanding enterprise customers. You’ll help organizations navigate the future of software development, from adopting AI across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to building effective developer tooling and platform environments.

Working across Eficode’s portfolio and technology ecosystem - including Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS and Microsoft Azure - you’ll identify opportunities where our consulting, workshops, migrations, managed services and software licensing can make a real difference.

This is a proactive, consultative sales role. You’ll combine a strong hunting mindset with the ability to understand customer challenges, bring in the right technical expertise and develop opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

  

**Role responsibilities**

**Your main responsibilities will include:**

* **Generate new pipeline** through strategic outbound activity and targeted sales campaigns across prospective and existing enterprise accounts.
* **Develop customer relationships**, engaging engineering, DevOps, procurement and business leaders to understand their challenges, priorities and growth plans.
* **Drive AI & SDLC opportunities**, helping customers explore AI readiness, tool adoption, workflow automation, AI agents and governance.
* **Shape tooling and platform conversations**, helping customers simplify fragmented developer toolchains and build effective, reliable platform environments.
* **Grow services and licensing opportunities** across consulting, workshops, migrations, platform acceleration, managed services and software licensing.
* **Partner with our technology ecosystem**, including Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS and Microsoft Azure, alongside Eficode’s internal solution specialists to develop and win opportunities.
* **Grow existing accounts** through cross-sell, upsell, software licence upgrades and renewals, building long-term customer value.
* **Own your pipeline and forecast**, maintaining accurate account plans, opportunities and revenue forecasts within Salesforce.

  

**How you will work**

This role is all about creating momentum - finding opportunities, understanding what matters to customers and connecting them with the right expertise from across Eficode.

* **Proactive:** You’re comfortable creating your own opportunities, opening doors and maintaining momentum even when sales cycles are complex.
* **Consultative:** You seek to understand the customer before selling, connecting their challenges and ambitions with solutions that create genuine value.
* **Commercially minded:** You can identify where services, software and long-term partnerships create value for both the customer and Eficode.
* **Curious:** You’re interested in how AI, DevOps, cloud and developer platforms are changing the way organizations build software.
* **Collaborative:** You work effectively with Sales, technical specialists, Delivery teams and technology partners to develop and win opportunities.
* **Results-driven:** You take ownership of your pipeline and are motivated by ambitious growth targets and measurable outcomes.

**Role requirements**

**You’ll make a great match for this role if you have:**

* **5+ years of B2B technology sales experience** across business development, account management, SaaS, software or IT professional services.
* **A proven hunting mindset**, with experience generating pipeline through proactive outbound activity and developing new opportunities.
* **A solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle**, DevOps, developer platforms and cloud environments.
* **Familiarity with technology ecosystems** such as Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* **Strong consultative selling and executive communication skills**, with the ability to understand customer challenges and articulate technical value and ROI.
* **Experience selling professional services**, technical workshops, cloud migrations, DevOps consulting or similar technology services.
* **Experience using Salesforce CRM** and modern sales engagement tools.
* **Willingness to travel** across the US for customer meetings and events, with occasional international travel.

**Nice-to-haves**

**It would be an added bonus if you have:**

* Knowledge of how AI is changing software development, including AI coding assistants, agents, automation and AI governance.
* Experience working within the Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab, AWS or Microsoft partner ecosystems.
* Experience developing opportunities through vendor co-selling and partner relationships.
* Experience selling a combination of professional services, managed services and software licensing.

**What’s in it for you?**

* The opportunity to play a key role in the continued growth of Eficode’s US bus

This role supports members in navigating services related to food insecurity, housing instability, transportation, utilities, and other social needs, while ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with NY Medicaid and SCN requirements.

* Identify eligible SCN services and determine appropriate next steps based on screening results
* Explain available social care services and member rights in clear, understandable language

**Care Navigation & Referral Coordination**

* Initiate and coordinate referrals to approved SCN vendors and community-based organizations
* Support members in completing referrals and overcoming barriers to service access
* Track referral outcomes and follow up to ensure services are initiated and completed
* Coordinate with care managers, health plans, and SCN partners as needed

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience conducting screenings, outreach, or care coordination in healthcare, social services, or community-based settings
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to engage diverse populations with sensitivity and professionalism
* Proficiency with electronic documentation systems and basic computer applications

**Event Operations Coordinator - POSSIBLE**  
  
**A bit about us**  
We’re Hyve - organizer of the world’s fastest-growing and most forward-thinking B2B events. As the chosen event partner to many of the world’s leading companies, our platforms play a critical role in their strategies - helping them enter new markets, accelerate growth and connect with the people who matter most.
  
  
Our portfolio features some of the world’s leading events in sectors like ecommerce, healthcare, edtech, and fintech. We’re growing fast with an entrepreneurial culture that empowers big ideas and quick action, plus an ambitious acquisition strategy bringing exciting new events into our mix.
  
  
Alongside our market-leading events, we’re building tech and data-driven products that supercharge connections – from one-to-one meeting programs and curated table talks to year-round engagement platforms. Whatever your role, you’ll join a global team redefining how industries connect, collaborate, and grow – working with some of the most talented people in the business.
  
  
Think that sounds good? Wait until our talent acquisition team tells you about the culture.

First things first: whatever your background, beliefs or ambitions, there’s a culture of belonging at Hyve — and everyone is welcome. The question isn’t where you’ve come from, but where you want to go.
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you’re curious, collaborative and not afraid to challenge convention. We look for people who take pride in what they do, who are excited by change and always moving forward. The kind of people who stay open, keep learning, and look for better ways to make an impact.

**Accommodation & Registration Support**

**Event Experience & Onsite Operations**  

* Support the delivery of attendee experiences, catering programs, networking events, and special activations.
* Assist with onsite event office setup, inventory management, staff coordination, and logistical execution.
* Serve as a key onsite team member, helping troubleshoot issues and ensure a seamless event experience.

**Documentation & Reporting**

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Partner closely with internal teams, including Marketing, Sales, Content, Registration, and Customer Success, to ensure seamless event execution.
