Operations Lead

**Direct oversight**

No formal direct people management responsibility unless assigned.

This role coordinates closely with internal specialists and delivery colleagues, including paid media and graphic design.

**Division**

CSR – Luxury Passenger Transportation (Chauffeur, Motorcoach)

Why this role exists

This role exists to manage client relationships, lead account strategy, and ensure high-quality, well-organized delivery across digital marketing activity.

The Account Manager is the primary day-to-day point of contact for assigned clients and is responsible for translating client goals into clear strategy, coordinated delivery, and a strong overall client experience.

The role also supports scalable delivery as the business grows by creating structure, consistency, and accountability across planning, communication, reporting, and internal coordination, while identifying opportunities to improve results and grow accounts where appropriate.

**What success looks like**

* · Clients feel well supported, informed, and confident in the service they receive
* · Client goals, priorities, and strategic direction are clearly defined and translated into practical delivery plans
* · Account strategy is owned proactively and reviewed regularly to ensure delivery remains aligned to objectives
* · Campaigns, content, and projects are delivered in a timely, organized and consistent way
* · Client onboarding is smooth, with clear agreement on priorities, goals, and strategic direction from the outset
* · Routine checks and reporting are completed consistently and used to guide actions and future planning
* · Strategy reviews help keep delivery aligned to changing client priorities and opportunities
* · Briefs for paid media, design, content, and related activity are clear, actionable, and well managed
* · Issues, blockers, delivery risks, and client concerns are identified early and followed through to resolution
* · Opportunities to improve client performance, strengthen client experience, and grow accounts are identified proactively
* · Documentation, plans, meeting notes, and status updates are kept accurate, organized and up to date

**Key responsibilitiesClient relationship management**

* · Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and maintain strong, professional, and trusted relationships
* · Lead day-to-day client communication, ensuring updates, requests, actions, recommendations, and next steps are clear and well managed
* · Build a strong understanding of each client’s business, goals, priorities, challenges, and opportunities
* · Provide a reliable and positive client experience through responsiveness, organisation, strategic guidance, and proactive communication
* · Manage communication cadence based on client needs, including more frequent communication for higher-intensity or fast-moving accounts

**Strategy ownership and planning**

* · Own the strategy for assigned accounts and ensure it is aligned to client goals, priorities, timelines, and commercial objectives
* · Lead strategy creation at the start of engagements using the agreed planning and design deck process
* · Translate client objectives into clear strategic priorities, channel plans, delivery actions, and measurable outcomes
* · Review and refine strategy on an ongoing basis using performance insights, delivery learnings, business context, and client feedback
* · Lead (quarterly) strategy work to assess progress, adjust focus, and identify new opportunities for impact and account growth

SENIOR BUSINESS ANALYST

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AOUSC). new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We’re seeking a Senior Technical Business Analyst to serve as a strategic partner between business and technology, leading complex initiatives from concept through delivery. In this role, you’ll translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, analyze complex systems and data, and help drive decisions across critical applications and integrations.

You’ll serve as a subject matter expert and mentor, partnering across business, development, architecture, data, and infrastructure teams to solve complex problems and deliver high-quality solutions aligned with business strategy.

**Essential Functions**

* Lead the analysis and documentation of complex business and technical requirements, translating business needs into comprehensive functional and technical specifications for enterprise systems, enhancements, and integrations.
* Serve as a thought partner to business and technology leaders by evaluating solution options, identifying dependencies and trade-offs, and recommending approaches that balance scalability, performance, risk, cost, and business needs.
* Use advanced SQL, backend data analysis, and application and database logs to validate system behavior, investigate complex issues, perform root cause analysis, and support defect resolution across production and non-production environments.
* Serve as a senior technical liaison between business stakeholders, development, architecture, data, and infrastructure teams to establish a shared understanding of requirements, system behavior, data flows, and technical dependencies.
* Lead analysis and ongoing support of complex system integrations, including APIs, event-driven architectures, file-based interfaces, middleware, ETL processes, and data exchanges between internal and third-party systems.
* Perform comprehensive impact and dependency analysis for proposed system, integration, and data changes, identifying downstream effects across applications, platforms, integrations, processes, and reporting.
* Provide leadership during incident response and major defect resolution by validating system behavior, coordinating investigative efforts, analyzing data and logs, and guiding teams toward effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain detailed technical and system documentation, including end-to-end workflows, data lineage, process flows, interface specifications, system dependencies, and operational playbooks.
* Lead and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by developing test scenarios, validating backend results, confirming data integrity, documenting defects, and ensuring expected system and integration outcomes.
* Partner closely with developers and engineers throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements, reproduce issues, validate solutions and fixes, and confirm successful implementation.
* Support production releases and implementations, including validating data loads and integrations, assessing release readiness, monitoring post-deployment performance, and responding to critical issues.
* Identify patterns in system defects, data quality issues, integration failures, and operational challenges, and proactively recommend process, configuration, or architectural improvements.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Technical Business Analysts and other team members, promoting best practices in requirements analysis, documentation, testing, and technical problem-solving.
Contribute to continuous improvement by helping establish and enhance standards, templates, tools, and analytical approaches across the organization.  

**Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline, or commensurate work experience, required
* 7 years of progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a closely related technical role, including experience supporting complex enterprise systems and integrations, required.
* Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying complex relational databases for data validation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and testing, required.
* Experience using Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) or comparable database management tools, required; experience with monitoring and logging platforms such as Datadog, preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with system integrations, APIs, data flows, backend processes, and enterprise applications, required.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum software development environments and partnering throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), required.
* Hands-on experience with work management, requirements documentation, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio, with experience developing technical documentation, workflows, and process flows.
* Experience within financial services, fintech, consumer lending, or another highly regulated industry, preferred.
* Professional certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI-PBA), or Agile-related certifications, preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Ability to independently manage complex analysis efforts while effectively collaborating across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
Availability to work outside of core business hours, including nights and weekends, as needed for system testing, upgrades, releases, and production implementations.

new_jobs.title: Paralegal and Case Manager - Personal Injury
new_jobs.description:
**About the Firm**

We will be a new West Virginia personal injury firm built on a simple premise: West Virginians injured deserve high caliber representation.

We are a velocity practice. We resolve cases at fair value, and when carriers refuse to make reasonable offers, we file. We are deliberately disciplined about case selection, deadline management, and client communication. The work product we deliver to courts, opposing counsel, and adjusters is held to the highest standard.

The firm's founding attorney is admitted in West Virginia, Virginia, and the District of Columbia and has been in active practice since 2007.

**What You'll Do**

During the launch ramp (months 1 through 6):

* Conduct detailed client intake and onboarding within 3 days of a signed fee agreement
* Track each client's medical treatment trajectory through Maximum Medical Improvement
* Maintain client communication on the firm's published cadence: biweekly status calls during stable treatment, weekly during active treatment, monthly during quiescent periods
* Order and organize medical records and bills as treatment progresses, not at the end
* Identify and track liens, subrogation claims, and reimbursement obligations (W.Va. Medicaid under § 9-5-11, Medicare MSP, ERISA self-funded plans, PEIA, hospital balances, LOP holders)
* Draft demand packages for attorney review and approval
* Run post-demand negotiation under attorney direction
* Coordinate disbursement and lien resolution on settled matters
* Help build and refine internal SOPs, intake checklists, and demand templates as the firm scales

**As the litigation track populates (month 6 forward):**

* Draft pleadings, discovery, and motions under attorney supervision
* Calendar all scheduling order deadlines under W.Va. Rule 16(b)(3) with redundant reminders
* Manage Rule 26(a)(1) initial disclosures, the Rule 26(f) conference and 14-day report, and discovery exchange under the 2025 amendments
* Coordinate depositions, exhibit and witness exchange, and trial logistics
* Track court deadlines, hearings, and trial dates
* Coordinate with local counsel in distant counties when in-person appearances are required

**Cross-cutting throughout:**

* Carry a target caseload of no fewer than 50 active matters once the firm is ramped (typically by month 5 to 6); your starting caseload will be smaller and grows with the firm
* Participate in monthly two-eyes statute of limitations reviews on every active matter
* File weekly status reports
* Surface operational gaps and undocumented procedures - we improve continuously

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of West Virginia plaintiff personal injury experience. This is firm. Out-of-state PI experience does not substitute for West Virginia experience, because the procedure, statutes, and local court culture are specific.
* Demonstrated current working knowledge of the 2025 West Virginia Rules of Civil Procedure amendments, including Rule 4 service revisions, the Rule 26 federalized discovery framework, Rule 30(d) deposition limits, and the Rule 6(d) motion briefing windows
* Working knowledge of West Virginia Magistrate Court procedure under the post-2025 $20,000 jurisdictional cap, including Rule 13 discovery limits and the Rule 18 / W.Va. Code § 50-5-12 appeal framework
* Demonstrated ability to draft demand packages, calculate special damages, and negotiate routine adjuster matters
* Demonstrated lien and subrogation experience: Medicaid, Medicare, ERISA, PEIA, hospital, and LOP
* Familiarity with W.Va. Code § 55-17-3 pre-suit notice requirements for state agency defendants and the broader pre-suit notice landscape for public defendants
* Comfort with statewide e-filing through the WV E-File / CourtPLUS system, mandatory in all 55 counties under TCR 15A
* Ability to manage a 40+ matter caseload without dropping deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience at a high-volume plaintiff PI firm
* Prior supervisory experience. As one of the first hires at a new firm, you will be a model and mentor for paralegal and case manager hires that follow you. Candidates who have run or trained junior staff are preferred.
* Prior trial support experience (exhibit preparation, witness coordination, trial-day logistics)
* Familiarity with the West Virginia Wrongful Death Act and minor-settlement approval procedures under W.Va. Code § 44-10-14

**What We Look For Beyond the Resume**

* Self-direction. You are joining a remote, brand-new firm. There is no team to lean on for the first several months. You need to be able to produce strong work without persistent in-person supervision.
* Velocity. You treat deadlines as binding and move every case forward every month.
* Ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
* Discipline. You follow documented procedures, file your weekly report on time, and surface operational issues rather than working around them.
* Care. Our clients are real people in pain. They are not files.

**Working Here**

* Fully remote. No commute. No central office requirement. We operate statewide.
* Modern stack. Cloud case management software, mandatory MFA, full-disk encryption, and firm-issued or firm-approved equipment.
* Quiet location, computer to yourself, no distractions. *All remote workers require standard monitoring software installed on either company computers or a private user account on their personal computer.*
* Real growth. Clear advancement path to Lead Paralegal as the firm's volume expands and additional paralegal and case manager hires come on board.

Pay: $53,000.00 - $74,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
